+                "american osteopathic association physician profile", "abps", "ancc", "nccpa",
+            ))
+            usable, date_reason = _reply_is_usable(rv, first_received, as_of)
+            if not accepted_source:
+                element.note("inadmissible_certification_source", f"Certification reply source {rv.get('received_from')!r} is not listed in the accepted-source table.", [_source_ref(rb, rr)])
+            elif not usable:
+                element.note("unusable_certification_date", date_reason, [_source_ref(rb, rr)])
+            else:
+                accepted.append((rb, rr))
+        if not accepted:
+            element.note("certification_verification_outstanding", f"No admissible, usable certification reply is on file for declaration {declaration_id!r}.", [_source_ref(decl_batch, decl_record)])
+            continue
+        responses = {(r["values"].get("certification_status"), r["values"].get("certificate_specialty"), r["values"].get("board_code")) for _, r in accepted}
+        if len(responses) > 1:
+            element.note("conflicting_certification_replies", f"Admissible replies conflict for declaration {declaration_id!r}; both are retained.", [_source_ref(b, r) for b, r in accepted])
+        for rb, rr in accepted:
+            rv = rr["values"]
+            if str(rv.get("certification_status") or "").casefold() == "not certified":
+                element.note("declared_certification_not_confirmed", f"Board reply does not confirm declared certification {declaration_id!r}.", [_source_ref(decl_batch, decl_record), _source_ref(rb, rr)])
+            verified.append((rb, rr, dv))
+
+    requests = [
+        (b, r) for b, r in rows
+        if r.get("filename") == "privilege-requests.csv"
+        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
+        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
+    ]
+    requested_codes = []
+    for b, r in requests:
+        element.cite(b, r)
+        requested_codes.append(str(r["values"].get("privilege_code") or ""))
+    if not requested_codes:
+        element.note("no_privilege_request", "No privilege group is recorded for this revision; support cannot be evaluated.")
+        return
+
+    support: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for code in requested_codes:
+        criteria = PRIVILEGES.get(code)
+        if not criteria:
+            support[code] = "unknown"
+            element.note("unknown_privilege_code", f"Privilege code {code!r} is absent from the published criteria table.", [_source_ref(b, r) for b, r in requests])
+            continue
+        code_supported = False
+        accreditation_missing = False
+        for rb, rr, declaration in verified:
+            cert = rr["values"]
+            board = str(cert.get("board_code") or "").upper()
+            specialty = str(cert.get("certificate_specialty") or "")
+            allowed_specialties = criteria["boards"].get(board, set())
+            status = str(cert.get("certification_status") or "").casefold()
+            active = status == "active"
+            eligible = status in {"board eligible", "eligible"}
+            if specialty not in allowed_specialties:
+                continue
+            if not active:
+                eligible_allowed = code in {"PRIV-FM", "PRIV-IM", "PRIV-HOSP", "PRIV-PED"}
+                expiry = _parse_date(cert.get("expiry_date"))
+                notes = str(cert.get("notes") or "").casefold()
+                if not (eligible and eligible_allowed and "good standing" in notes and expiry is not None and expiry > as_of):
+                    continue
+            training_ok, training_evidence, training_accreditation_missing = _training_support(
+                criteria["training"], history, rows, application_id, first_received, as_of, docs
+            )
+            accreditation_missing = accreditation_missing or training_accreditation_missing
+            if training_ok:
+                code_supported = True
+                element.cite(rb, rr)
+                for ref in training_evidence:
+                    if ref not in element.evidence:
+                        element.evidence.append(ref)
+                break
+        if code_supported:

+        elif accreditation_missing:

+    element.observations.append({
+        "code": "privilege_support_map",
+        "message": "Group support is mapped from verified certification, published board/specialty criteria, and verified training only; current competency is not evaluated.",
+        "support_by_privilege": support,
+        "evidence": element.evidence.copy(),
+    })
+    supported = [code for code, value in support.items() if value == "supported"]
+    if not supported:
+        element.note("threshold_eligibility_question", "No requested group is established as supported by verified evidence at this export date; this raises the documented eligibility question and does not decide it.", element.evidence)
+        element.problems.add("eligibility-question")
+    elif any(value == "unsupported-on-verified-evidence" for value in support.values()):
+        element.note("unsupported_requested_privilege", "One or more requested privilege groups are unsupported on verified evidence; retain the named subset.", element.evidence)
+    elif any(value == "not-established" for value in support.values()):
+        element.note("privilege_support_not_established", "Accreditation is not present in the available evidence fields for one or more requested groups.", element.evidence)

+def _reference_element(
+    element: _Element, rows: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]], app: dict[str, Any],
+    application_id: str, revision: str, as_of: date,
+) -> None:
+    referees = [
+        (b, r) for b, r in rows
+        if r.get("filename") == "peer-referees.csv"
+        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
+        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
+    ]
+    replies = [
+        (b, r) for b, r in rows
+        if r.get("filename") == "peer-reference-replies.csv"
+        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
+    ]
+    for b, r in referees:
+        element.cite(b, r)
+    discipline = str(app.get("discipline") or "").strip().casefold()
+    cutoff = _subtract_years(as_of, 2)
+    valid_count = 0
+    for referee_batch, referee_record in referees:
+        referee = referee_record["values"]
+        referee_id = str(referee.get("referee_id") or "")
+        matching = [(b, r) for b, r in replies if r["values"].get("referee_id") == referee_id]
+        if not matching:
+            element.note("reference_outstanding", f"No returned reference is recorded for referee {referee_id!r}.", [_source_ref(referee_batch, referee_record)])
+            continue
+        for reply_batch, reply_record in matching:
+            reply = reply_record["values"]
+            element.cite(reply_batch, reply_record)
+            signature = _parse_date(reply.get("signature_date"))
+            received = _parse_date(reply.get("received_date"))
+            if not signature or not received or received > as_of or signature > as_of:
+                element.note("reference_date_unusable", f"Reference {referee_id!r} has missing or future signature/received date.", [_source_ref(reply_batch, reply_record)])
+                continue
+            reasons = []
+            last_work = _parse_date(reply.get("last_worked_together_end"))
+            if last_work is not None and last_work < _subtract_years(signature, 2):
+                reasons.append("direct work ended more than two years before signature")
+            stated_discipline = str(reply.get("referee_specialty_stated") or "").strip().casefold()
+            if not stated_discipline or stated_discipline != discipline:
+                reasons.append("referee discipline does not match the applicant's declared discipline")
+            related = str(reply.get("related_or_partner") or "").strip().casefold()
+            if related not in {"no", "false"}:
+                reasons.append("relationship exclusion is not affirmatively cleared")
+            if signature < cutoff:
+                reasons.append("signature is older than two years at this export date")
+            if reasons:
+                element.note("reference_not_countable", f"Reference {referee_id!r} is not countable: " + "; ".join(reasons) + ".", [
+                    _source_ref(referee_batch, referee_record), _source_ref(reply_batch, reply_record)
+                ])
+                continue
+            valid_count += 1
+    if valid_count >= 2:
+        element.observations.append({
+            "code": "two_qualifying_current_references",
+            "message": f"{valid_count} references satisfy the recorded date, discipline, and relationship checks as of {as_of.isoformat()}.",
+            "evidence": element.evidence.copy(),
+        })
+        element.observations.append({
+            "code": "source_channel_not_exported",
+            "message": SOURCE_LIMITATIONS[0],
+        })
+    else:
+        element.note("two_references_not_established", f"Only {valid_count} references are established as qualifying and current; at least two are required.", element.evidence)
+        element.problems.add("outstanding")
+
+
+def evaluate_application(
+    ledger: dict[str, Any], application_id: str, revision: str | int, export_date: str | date
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Evaluate the six element states for a specific revision as of an export date."""
+    as_of = export_date if isinstance(export_date, date) else _parse_date(export_date)
+    if as_of is None:
+        raise ValueError("export_date must be a valid YYYY-MM-DD date")
+    revision = str(revision)
+    rows = _row_records(ledger, as_of)
+    app_rows = [
+        (b, r) for b, r in rows
+        if r.get("filename") == "applications.csv"
+        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
+        and str(r.get("values", {}).get("revision")) == revision
+    ]
+    if not app_rows:
+        raise ValueError(f"Application revision {application_id}/{revision} is not present on or before {as_of.isoformat()}")
+    app = app_rows[-1][1]["values"]
+    first_received_rows = [
+        (b, r) for b, r in rows
+        if r.get("filename") == "applications.csv"
+        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
+        and str(r.get("values", {}).get("revision")) == "1"
+    ]
+    first_received = _parse_date(first_received_rows[0][1]["values"].get("first_received_date")) if first_received_rows else None
+    first_received = first_received or _parse_date(app.get("first_received_date"))
+    if first_received is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"First-received date is unavailable for {application_id}")
+
+    docs = _doc_index(ledger, as_of, application_id)
+    elements = {name: _Element(name) for name in ("licensure", "experience", "gaps", "education", "certification", "references")}
+    for batch, record in app_rows:
+        for name in elements:
+            elements[name].cite(batch, record)
+
+    _license_element(elements["licensure"], rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of, docs)
+    _education_experience_elements(elements, rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of, first_received, docs)
+    history = [
+        (b, r) for b, r in rows
+        if r.get("filename") == "declared-history.csv"
+        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
+        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
+    ]
+    _gaps_element(elements["gaps"], history, docs, as_of)
+    _certification_element(elements["certification"], rows, app, application_id, revision, first_received, as_of, docs)
+    _reference_element(elements["references"], rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of)
+
+    details = {name: element.finish() for name, element in elements.items()}
+    return {
+        "application_id": application_id,
+        "revision": int(revision) if revision.isdigit() else revision,
+        "as_of": as_of.isoformat(),
+        "elements": {name: details[name]["state"] for name in details},
+        "element_details": details,

def _certification_element(
    element: _Element, rows: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]], app: dict[str, Any],
    application_id: str, revision: str, first_received: date, as_of: date,
    docs: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]],
) -> None:
    declarations = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "declared-credentials.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
        and str(r.get("values", {}).get("credential_class") or "").casefold() in {"certification", "certificate"}
    ]
    history = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "declared-history.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    for b, r in declarations:
        element.cite(b, r)
    replies_by_declaration: dict[str, list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]]] = {}
    for b, r in rows:
        if r.get("filename") == "certification-replies.csv" and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id:
            replies_by_declaration.setdefault(str(r["values"].get("declaration_id") or ""), []).append((b, r))

    verified: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]] = []
    for decl_batch, decl_record in declarations:
        dv = decl_record["values"]
        declaration_id = str(dv.get("declaration_id") or "")
        replies = replies_by_declaration.get(declaration_id, [])
        accepted = []
        for rb, rr in replies:
            rv = rr["values"]
            element.cite(rb, rr)
            received = str(rv.get("received_from") or "").casefold()
            board_code = str(rv.get("board_code") or "").upper()
            accepted_source = received.startswith("certifying board") or any(name in received for name in (
                "abms", "certifacts", "american medical association physician profile",
                "american osteopathic association physician profile", "abps", "ancc", "nccpa",
            ))
            usable, date_reason = _reply_is_usable(rv, first_received, as_of)
            if not accepted_source:
                element.note("inadmissible_certification_source", f"Certification reply source {rv.get('received_from')!r} is not listed in the accepted-source table.", [_source_ref(rb, rr)])
            elif not usable:
                element.note("unusable_certification_date", date_reason, [_source_ref(rb, rr)])
            else:
                accepted.append((rb, rr))
        if not accepted:
            element.note("certification_verification_outstanding", f"No admissible, usable certification reply is on file for declaration {declaration_id!r}.", [_source_ref(decl_batch, decl_record)])
            continue
        responses = {(r["values"].get("certification_status"), r["values"].get("certificate_specialty"), r["values"].get("board_code")) for _, r in accepted}
        if len(responses) > 1:
            element.note("conflicting_certification_replies", f"Admissible replies conflict for declaration {declaration_id!r}; both are retained.", [_source_ref(b, r) for b, r in accepted])
        for rb, rr in accepted:
            rv = rr["values"]
            if str(rv.get("certification_status") or "").casefold() == "not certified":
                element.note("declared_certification_not_confirmed", f"Board reply does not confirm declared certification {declaration_id!r}.", [_source_ref(decl_batch, decl_record), _source_ref(rb, rr)])
            verified.append((rb, rr, dv))

    requests = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "privilege-requests.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    requested_codes = []
    for b, r in requests:
        element.cite(b, r)
        requested_codes.append(str(r["values"].get("privilege_code") or ""))
    if not requested_codes:
        element.note("no_privilege_request", "No privilege group is recorded for this revision; support cannot be evaluated.")
        return

    support: dict[str, str] = {}
    for code in requested_codes:
        criteria = PRIVILEGES.get(code)
        if not criteria:
            support[code] = "unknown"
            element.note("unknown_privilege_code", f"Privilege code {code!r} is absent from the published criteria table.", [_source_ref(b, r) for b, r in requests])
            continue
        code_supported = False
        accreditation_missing = False
        for rb, rr, declaration in verified:
            cert = rr["values"]
            board = str(cert.get("board_code") or "").upper()
            specialty = str(cert.get("certificate_specialty") or "")
            allowed_specialties = criteria["boards"].get(board, set())
            status = str(cert.get("certification_status") or "").casefold()
            active = status == "active"
            eligible = status in {"board eligible", "eligible"}
            if specialty not in allowed_specialties:
                continue
            if not active:
                eligible_allowed = code in {"PRIV-FM", "PRIV-IM", "PRIV-HOSP", "PRIV-PED"}
                expiry = _parse_date(cert.get("expiry_date"))
                notes = str(cert.get("notes") or "").casefold()
                if not (eligible and eligible_allowed and "good standing" in notes and expiry is not None and expiry > as_of):
                    continue
            training_ok, training_evidence, training_accreditation_missing = _training_support(
                criteria["training"], history, rows, application_id, first_received, as_of, docs
            )
            accreditation_missing = accreditation_missing or training_accreditation_missing
            if training_ok:
                code_supported = True
                element.cite(rb, rr)
                for ref in training_evidence:
                    if ref not in element.evidence:
                        element.evidence.append(ref)
                break
        if code_supported:
            support[code] = "supported"
        elif accreditation_missing:
            support[code] = "not-established"
        else:
            support[code] = "unsupported-on-verified-evidence"

    element.observations.append({
        "code": "privilege_support_map",
        "message": "Group support is mapped from verified certification, published board/specialty criteria, and verified training only; current competency is not evaluated.",
        "support_by_privilege": support,
        "evidence": element.evidence.copy(),
    })
    supported = [code for code, value in support.items() if value == "supported"]
    if not supported:
        element.note("threshold_eligibility_question", "No requested group is established as supported by verified evidence at this export date; this raises the documented eligibility question and does not decide it.", element.evidence)
        element.problems.add("eligibility-question")
    elif any(value == "unsupported-on-verified-evidence" for value in support.values()):
        element.note("unsupported_requested_privilege", "One or more requested privilege groups are unsupported on verified evidence; retain the named subset.", element.evidence)
    elif any(value == "not-established" for value in support.values()):
        element.note("privilege_support_not_established", "Accreditation is not present in the available evidence fields for one or more requested groups.", element.evidence)
        element.problems.add("outstanding")


def _reference_element(
    element: _Element, rows: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]], app: dict[str, Any],
    application_id: str, revision: str, as_of: date,
) -> None:
    referees = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "peer-referees.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    replies = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "peer-reference-replies.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
    ]
    for b, r in referees:
        element.cite(b, r)
    discipline = str(app.get("discipline") or "").strip().casefold()
    cutoff = _subtract_years(as_of, 2)
    valid_count = 0
    for referee_batch, referee_record in referees:
        referee = referee_record["values"]
        referee_id = str(referee.get("referee_id") or "")
        matching = [(b, r) for b, r in replies if r["values"].get("referee_id") == referee_id]
        if not matching:
            element.note("reference_outstanding", f"No returned reference is recorded for referee {referee_id!r}.", [_source_ref(referee_batch, referee_record)])
            continue
        for reply_batch, reply_record in matching:
            reply = reply_record["values"]
            element.cite(reply_batch, reply_record)
            signature = _parse_date(reply.get("signature_date"))
            received = _parse_date(reply.get("received_date"))
            if not signature or not received or received > as_of or signature > as_of:
                element.note("reference_date_unusable", f"Reference {referee_id!r} has missing or future signature/received date.", [_source_ref(reply_batch, reply_record)])
                continue
            reasons = []
            last_work = _parse_date(reply.get("last_worked_together_end"))
            if last_work is not None and last_work < _subtract_years(signature, 2):
                reasons.append("direct work ended more than two years before signature")
            stated_discipline = str(reply.get("referee_specialty_stated") or "").strip().casefold()
            if not stated_discipline or stated_discipline != discipline:
                reasons.append("referee discipline does not match the applicant's declared discipline")
            related = str(reply.get("related_or_partner") or "").strip().casefold()
            if related not in {"no", "false"}:
                reasons.append("relationship exclusion is not affirmatively cleared")
            if signature < cutoff:
                reasons.append("signature is older than two years at this export date")
            if reasons:
                element.note("reference_not_countable", f"Reference {referee_id!r} is not countable: " + "; ".join(reasons) + ".", [
                    _source_ref(referee_batch, referee_record), _source_ref(reply_batch, reply_record)
                ])
                continue
            valid_count += 1
    if valid_count >= 2:
        element.observations.append({
            "code": "two_qualifying_current_references",
            "message": f"{valid_count} references satisfy the recorded date, discipline, and relationship checks as of {as_of.isoformat()}.",
            "evidence": element.evidence.copy(),
        })
        element.observations.append({
            "code": "source_channel_not_exported",
            "message": SOURCE_LIMITATIONS[0],
        })
    else:
        element.note("two_references_not_established", f"Only {valid_count} references are established as qualifying and current; at least two are required.", element.evidence)
        element.problems.add("outstanding")


def evaluate_application(
    ledger: dict[str, Any], application_id: str, revision: str | int, export_date: str | date
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Evaluate the six element states for a specific revision as of an export date."""
    as_of = export_date if isinstance(export_date, date) else _parse_date(export_date)
    if as_of is None:
        raise ValueError("export_date must be a valid YYYY-MM-DD date")
    revision = str(revision)
    rows = _row_records(ledger, as_of)
    app_rows = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "applications.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and str(r.get("values", {}).get("revision")) == revision
    ]
    if not app_rows:
        raise ValueError(f"Application revision {application_id}/{revision} is not present on or before {as_of.isoformat()}")
    app = app_rows[-1][1]["values"]
    first_received_rows = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "applications.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and str(r.get("values", {}).get("revision")) == "1"
    ]
    first_received = _parse_date(first_received_rows[0][1]["values"].get("first_received_date")) if first_received_rows else None
    first_received = first_received or _parse_date(app.get("first_received_date"))
    if first_received is None:
        raise ValueError(f"First-received date is unavailable for {application_id}")

    docs = _doc_index(ledger, as_of, application_id)
    elements = {name: _Element(name) for name in ("licensure", "experience", "gaps", "education", "certification", "references")}
    for batch, record in app_rows:
        for name in elements:
            elements[name].cite(batch, record)

    _license_element(elements["licensure"], rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of, docs)
    _education_experience_elements(elements, rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of, first_received, docs)
    history = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "declared-history.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    _gaps_element(elements["gaps"], history, docs, as_of)
    _certification_element(elements["certification"], rows, app, application_id, revision, first_received, as_of, docs)
    _reference_element(elements["references"], rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of)

    details = {name: element.finish() for name, element in elements.items()}
    return {
        "application_id": application_id,
        "revision": int(revision) if revision.isdigit() else revision,
        "as_of": as_of.isoformat(),
        "elements": {name: details[name]["state"] for name in details},
        "element_details": details,
        "assumptions": [
            "For an undecided file, export_date is used as the reference date for evidence known/current at that export; this is not a committee decision date.",
            "A peer-reference row in peer-reference-replies.csv is treated as a returned office record for eligibility calculations, but the unexported return channel is reported as a limitation.",
        ],
        "unresolved_policy_questions": SOURCE_LIMITATIONS,
    }

    replies_by_declaration: dict[str, list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]]] = {}
    for b, r in rows:
        if r.get("filename") == "certification-replies.csv" and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id:
            replies_by_declaration.setdefault(str(r["values"].get("declaration_id") or ""), []).append((b, r))

    verified: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]] = []
    for decl_batch, decl_record in declarations:
        dv = decl_record["values"]
        declaration_id = str(dv.get("declaration_id") or "")
        replies = replies_by_declaration.get(declaration_id, [])
        accepted = []
        for rb, rr in replies:
            rv = rr["values"]
            element.cite(rb, rr)
            received = str(rv.get("received_from") or "").casefold()
            board_code = str(rv.get("board_code") or "").upper()
            accepted_source = received.startswith("certifying board") or any(name in received for name in (
                "abms", "certifacts", "american medical association physician profile",
                "american osteopathic association physician profile", "abps", "ancc", "nccpa",
            ))
            usable, date_reason = _reply_is_usable(rv, first_received, as_of)
            if not accepted_source:
                element.note("inadmissible_certification_source", f"Certification reply source {rv.get('received_from')!r} is not listed in the accepted-source table.", [_source_ref(rb, rr)])
            elif not usable:
                element.note("unusable_certification_date", date_reason, [_source_ref(rb, rr)])
            else:
                accepted.append((rb, rr))
        if not accepted:
            element.note("certification_verification_outstanding", f"No admissible, usable certification reply is on file for declaration {declaration_id!r}.", [_source_ref(decl_batch, decl_record)])
            continue
        responses = {(r["values"].get("certification_status"), r["values"].get("certificate_specialty"), r["values"].get("board_code")) for _, r in accepted}
        if len(responses) > 1:
            element.note("conflicting_certification_replies", f"Admissible replies conflict for declaration {declaration_id!r}; both are retained.", [_source_ref(b, r) for b, r in accepted])
        for rb, rr in accepted:
            rv = rr["values"]
            if str(rv.get("certification_status") or "").casefold() == "not certified":
                element.note("declared_certification_not_confirmed", f"Board reply does not confirm declared certification {declaration_id!r}.", [_source_ref(decl_batch, decl_record), _source_ref(rb, rr)])
            verified.append((rb, rr, dv))

    requests = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "privilege-requests.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    requested_codes = []
    for b, r in requests:
        element.cite(b, r)
        requested_codes.append(str(r["values"].get("privilege_code") or ""))
    if not requested_codes:
        element.note("no_privilege_request", "No privilege group is recorded for this revision; support cannot be evaluated.")
        return

    support: dict[str, str] = {}
    for code in requested_codes:
        criteria = PRIVILEGES.get(code)
        if not criteria:
            support[code] = "unknown"
            element.note("unknown_privilege_code", f"Privilege code {code!r} is absent from the published criteria table.", [_source_ref(b, r) for b, r in requests])
            continue
        code_supported = False
        accreditation_missing = False
        for rb, rr, declaration in verified:
            cert = rr["values"]
            board = str(cert.get("board_code") or "").upper()
            specialty = str(cert.get("certificate_specialty") or "")
            allowed_specialties = criteria["boards"].get(board, set())
            status = str(cert.get("certification_status") or "").casefold()
            active = status == "active"
            eligible = status in {"board eligible", "eligible"}
            if specialty not in allowed_specialties:
                continue
            if not active:
                eligible_allowed = code in {"PRIV-FM", "PRIV-IM", "PRIV-HOSP", "PRIV-PED"}
                expiry = _parse_date(cert.get("expiry_date"))
                notes = str(cert.get("notes") or "").casefold()
                if not (eligible and eligible_allowed and "good standing" in notes and expiry is not None and expiry > as_of):
                    continue
            training_ok, training_evidence, training_accreditation_missing = _training_support(
                criteria["training"], history, rows, application_id, first_received, as_of, docs
            )
            accreditation_missing = accreditation_missing or training_accreditation_missing
            if training_ok:
                code_supported = True
                element.cite(rb, rr)
                for ref in training_evidence:
                    if ref not in element.evidence:
                        element.evidence.append(ref)
                break
        if code_supported:
            support[code] = "supported"
        elif accreditation_missing:
            support[code] = "not-established"
        else:
            support[code] = "unsupported-on-verified-evidence"

    element.observations.append({
        "code": "privilege_support_map",
        "message": "Group support is mapped from verified certification, published board/specialty criteria, and verified training only; current competency is not evaluated.",
        "support_by_privilege": support,
        "evidence": element.evidence.copy(),
    })
    supported = [code for code, value in support.items() if value == "supported"]
    if not supported:
        element.note("threshold_eligibility_question", "No requested group is established as supported by verified evidence at this export date; this raises the documented eligibility question and does not decide it.", element.evidence)
        element.problems.add("eligibility-question")
    elif any(value == "unsupported-on-verified-evidence" for value in support.values()):
        element.note("unsupported_requested_privilege", "One or more requested privilege groups are unsupported on verified evidence; retain the named subset.", element.evidence)
    elif any(value == "not-established" for value in support.values()):
        element.note("privilege_support_not_established", "Accreditation is not present in the available evidence fields for one or more requested groups.", element.evidence)
        element.problems.add("outstanding")


def _reference_element(
    element: _Element, rows: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]], app: dict[str, Any],
    application_id: str, revision: str, as_of: date,
) -> None:
    referees = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "peer-referees.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    replies = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "peer-reference-replies.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
    ]
    for b, r in referees:
        element.cite(b, r)
    discipline = str(app.get("discipline") or "").strip().casefold()
    cutoff = _subtract_years(as_of, 2)
    valid_count = 0
    for referee_batch, referee_record in referees:
        referee = referee_record["values"]
        referee_id = str(referee.get("referee_id") or "")
        matching = [(b, r) for b, r in replies if r["values"].get("referee_id") == referee_id]
        if not matching:
            element.note("reference_outstanding", f"No returned reference is recorded for referee {referee_id!r}.", [_source_ref(referee_batch, referee_record)])
            continue
        for reply_batch, reply_record in matching:
            reply = reply_record["values"]
            element.cite(reply_batch, reply_record)
            signature = _parse_date(reply.get("signature_date"))
            received = _parse_date(reply.get("received_date"))
            if not signature or not received or received > as_of or signature > as_of:
                element.note("reference_date_unusable", f"Reference {referee_id!r} has missing or future signature/received date.", [_source_ref(reply_batch, reply_record)])
                continue
            reasons = []
            last_work = _parse_date(reply.get("last_worked_together_end"))
            if last_work is not None and last_work < _subtract_years(signature, 2):
                reasons.append("direct work ended more than two years before signature")
            stated_discipline = str(reply.get("referee_specialty_stated") or "").strip().casefold()
            if not stated_discipline or stated_discipline != discipline:
                reasons.append("referee discipline does not match the applicant's declared discipline")
            related = str(reply.get("related_or_partner") or "").strip().casefold()
            if related not in {"no", "false"}:
                reasons.append("relationship exclusion is not affirmatively cleared")
            if signature < cutoff:
                reasons.append("signature is older than two years at this export date")
            if reasons:
                element.note("reference_not_countable", f"Reference {referee_id!r} is not countable: " + "; ".join(reasons) + ".", [
                    _source_ref(referee_batch, referee_record), _source_ref(reply_batch, reply_record)
                ])
                continue
            valid_count += 1
    if valid_count >= 2:
        element.observations.append({
            "code": "two_qualifying_current_references",
            "message": f"{valid_count} references satisfy the recorded date, discipline, and relationship checks as of {as_of.isoformat()}.",
            "evidence": element.evidence.copy(),
        })
        element.observations.append({
            "code": "source_channel_not_exported",
            "message": SOURCE_LIMITATIONS[0],
        })
    else:
        element.note("two_references_not_established", f"Only {valid_count} references are established as qualifying and current; at least two are required.", element.evidence)
        element.problems.add("outstanding")


def evaluate_application(
    ledger: dict[str, Any], application_id: str, revision: str | int, export_date: str | date
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Evaluate the six element states for a specific revision as of an export date."""
    as_of = export_date if isinstance(export_date, date) else _parse_date(export_date)
    if as_of is None:
        raise ValueError("export_date must be a valid YYYY-MM-DD date")
    revision = str(revision)
    rows = _row_records(ledger, as_of)
    app_rows = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "applications.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and str(r.get("values", {}).get("revision")) == revision
    ]
    if not app_rows:
        raise ValueError(f"Application revision {application_id}/{revision} is not present on or before {as_of.isoformat()}")
    app = app_rows[-1][1]["values"]
    first_received_rows = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "applications.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and str(r.get("values", {}).get("revision")) == "1"
    ]
    first_received = _parse_date(first_received_rows[0][1]["values"].get("first_received_date")) if first_received_rows else None
    first_received = first_received or _parse_date(app.get("first_received_date"))
    if first_received is None:
        raise ValueError(f"First-received date is unavailable for {application_id}")

    docs = _doc_index(ledger, as_of, application_id)
    elements = {name: _Element(name) for name in ("licensure", "experience", "gaps", "education", "certification", "references")}
    for batch, record in app_rows:
        for name in elements:
            elements[name].cite(batch, record)

    _license_element(elements["licensure"], rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of, docs)
    _education_experience_elements(elements, rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of, first_received, docs)
    history = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "declared-history.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    _gaps_element(elements["gaps"], history, docs, as_of)
    _certification_element(elements["certification"], rows, app, application_id, revision, first_received, as_of, docs)
    _reference_element(elements["references"], rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of)

    details = {name: element.finish() for name, element in elements.items()}
    return {
        "application_id": application_id,
        "revision": int(revision) if revision.isdigit() else revision,
        "as_of": as_of.isoformat(),
        "elements": {name: details[name]["state"] for name in details},
        "element_details": details,
        "assumptions": [
            "For an undecided file, export_date is used as the reference date for evidence known/current at that export; this is not a committee decision date.",
            "A peer-reference row in peer-reference-replies.csv is treated as a returned office record for eligibility calculations, but the unexported return channel is reported as a limitation.",
        ],
        "unresolved_policy_questions": SOURCE_LIMITATIONS,
    }

def _certification_element(
    element: _Element, rows: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]], app: dict[str, Any],
    application_id: str, revision: str, first_received: date, as_of: date,
    docs: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]],
) -> None:
    declarations = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "declared-credentials.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
        and str(r.get("values", {}).get("credential_class") or "").casefold() in {"certification", "certificate"}
    ]
    history = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "declared-history.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    for b, r in declarations:
        element.cite(b, r)
    replies_by_declaration: dict[str, list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]]] = {}
    for b, r in rows:
        if r.get("filename") == "certification-replies.csv" and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id:
            replies_by_declaration.setdefault(str(r["values"].get("declaration_id") or ""), []).append((b, r))

    verified: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]] = []
    for decl_batch, decl_record in declarations:
        dv = decl_record["values"]
        declaration_id = str(dv.get("declaration_id") or "")
        replies = replies_by_declaration.get(declaration_id, [])
        accepted = []
        for rb, rr in replies:
            rv = rr["values"]
            element.cite(rb, rr)
            received = str(rv.get("received_from") or "").casefold()
            board_code = str(rv.get("board_code") or "").upper()
            accepted_source = received.startswith("certifying board") or any(name in received for name in (
                "abms", "certifacts", "american medical association physician profile",
                "american osteopathic association physician profile", "abps", "ancc", "nccpa",
            ))
            usable, date_reason = _reply_is_usable(rv, first_received, as_of)
            if not accepted_source:
                element.note("inadmissible_certification_source", f"Certification reply source {rv.get('received_from')!r} is not listed in the accepted-source table.", [_source_ref(rb, rr)])
            elif not usable:
                element.note("unusable_certification_date", date_reason, [_source_ref(rb, rr)])
            else:
                accepted.append((rb, rr))
        if not accepted:
            element.note("certification_verification_outstanding", f"No admissible, usable certification reply is on file for declaration {declaration_id!r}.", [_source_ref(decl_batch, decl_record)])
            continue
        responses = {(r["values"].get("certification_status"), r["values"].get("certificate_specialty"), r["values"].get("board_code")) for _, r in accepted}
        if len(responses) > 1:
            element.note("conflicting_certification_replies", f"Admissible replies conflict for declaration {declaration_id!r}; both are retained.", [_source_ref(b, r) for b, r in accepted])
        for rb, rr in accepted:
            rv = rr["values"]
            if str(rv.get("certification_status") or "").casefold() == "not certified":
                element.note("declared_certification_not_confirmed", f"Board reply does not confirm declared certification {declaration_id!r}.", [_source_ref(decl_batch, decl_record), _source_ref(rb, rr)])
            verified.append((rb, rr, dv))

    requests = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "privilege-requests.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    requested_codes = []
    for b, r in requests:
        element.cite(b, r)
        requested_codes.append(str(r["values"].get("privilege_code") or ""))
    if not requested_codes:
        element.note("no_privilege_request", "No privilege group is recorded for this revision; support cannot be evaluated.")
        return

    support: dict[str, str] = {}
    for code in requested_codes:
        criteria = PRIVILEGES.get(code)
        if not criteria:
            support[code] = "unknown"
            element.note("unknown_privilege_code", f"Privilege code {code!r} is absent from the published criteria table.", [_source_ref(b, r) for b, r in requests])
            continue
        code_supported = False
        accreditation_missing = False
        for rb, rr, declaration in verified:
            cert = rr["values"]
            board = str(cert.get("board_code") or "").upper()
            specialty = str(cert.get("certificate_specialty") or "")
            allowed_specialties = criteria["boards"].get(board, set())
            status = str(cert.get("certification_status") or "").casefold()
            active = status == "active"
            eligible = status in {"board eligible", "eligible"}
            if specialty not in allowed_specialties:
                continue
            if not active:
                eligible_allowed = code in {"PRIV-FM", "PRIV-IM", "PRIV-HOSP", "PRIV-PED"}
                expiry = _parse_date(cert.get("expiry_date"))
                notes = str(cert.get("notes") or "").casefold()
                if not (eligible and eligible_allowed and "good standing" in notes and expiry is not None and expiry > as_of):
                    continue
            training_ok, training_evidence, training_accreditation_missing = _training_support(
                criteria["training"], history, rows, application_id, first_received, as_of, docs
            )
            accreditation_missing = accreditation_missing or training_accreditation_missing
            if training_ok:
                code_supported = True
                element.cite(rb, rr)
                for ref in training_evidence:
                    if ref not in element.evidence:
                        element.evidence.append(ref)
                break
        if code_supported:
            support[code] = "supported"
        elif accreditation_missing:
            support[code] = "not-established"
        else:
            support[code] = "unsupported-on-verified-evidence"

    element.observations.append({
        "code": "privilege_support_map",
        "message": "Group support is mapped from verified certification, published board/specialty criteria, and verified training only; current competency is not evaluated.",
        "support_by_privilege": support,
        "evidence": element.evidence.copy(),
    })
    supported = [code for code, value in support.items() if value == "supported"]
    if not supported:
        element.note("threshold_eligibility_question", "No requested group is established as supported by verified evidence at this export date; this raises the documented eligibility question and does not decide it.", element.evidence)
        element.problems.add("eligibility-question")
    elif any(value == "unsupported-on-verified-evidence" for value in support.values()):
        element.note("unsupported_requested_privilege", "One or more requested privilege groups are unsupported on verified evidence; retain the named subset.", element.evidence)
    elif any(value == "not-established" for value in support.values()):
        element.note("privilege_support_not_established", "Accreditation is not present in the available evidence fields for one or more requested groups.", element.evidence)
        element.problems.add("outstanding")


def _reference_element(
    element: _Element, rows: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]], app: dict[str, Any],
    application_id: str, revision: str, as_of: date,
) -> None:
    referees = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "peer-referees.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    replies = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "peer-reference-replies.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
    ]
    for b, r in referees:
        element.cite(b, r)
    discipline = str(app.get("discipline") or "").strip().casefold()
    cutoff = _subtract_years(as_of, 2)
    valid_count = 0
    for referee_batch, referee_record in referees:
        referee = referee_record["values"]
        referee_id = str(referee.get("referee_id") or "")
        matching = [(b, r) for b, r in replies if r["values"].get("referee_id") == referee_id]
        if not matching:
            element.note("reference_outstanding", f"No returned reference is recorded for referee {referee_id!r}.", [_source_ref(referee_batch, referee_record)])
            continue
        for reply_batch, reply_record in matching:
            reply = reply_record["values"]
            element.cite(reply_batch, reply_record)
            signature = _parse_date(reply.get("signature_date"))
            received = _parse_date(reply.get("received_date"))
            if not signature or not received or received > as_of or signature > as_of:
                element.note("reference_date_unusable", f"Reference {referee_id!r} has missing or future signature/received date.", [_source_ref(reply_batch, reply_record)])
                continue
            reasons = []
            last_work = _parse_date(reply.get("last_worked_together_end"))
            if last_work is not None and last_work < _subtract_years(signature, 2):
                reasons.append("direct work ended more than two years before signature")
            stated_discipline = str(reply.get("referee_specialty_stated") or "").strip().casefold()
            if not stated_discipline or stated_discipline != discipline:
                reasons.append("referee discipline does not match the applicant's declared discipline")
            related = str(reply.get("related_or_partner") or "").strip().casefold()
            if related not in {"no", "false"}:
                reasons.append("relationship exclusion is not affirmatively cleared")
            if signature < cutoff:
                reasons.append("signature is older than two years at this export date")
            if reasons:
                element.note("reference_not_countable", f"Reference {referee_id!r} is not countable: " + "; ".join(reasons) + ".", [
                    _source_ref(referee_batch, referee_record), _source_ref(reply_batch, reply_record)
                ])
                continue
            valid_count += 1
    if valid_count >= 2:
        element.observations.append({
            "code": "two_qualifying_current_references",
            "message": f"{valid_count} references satisfy the recorded date, discipline, and relationship checks as of {as_of.isoformat()}.",
            "evidence": element.evidence.copy(),
        })
        element.observations.append({
            "code": "source_channel_not_exported",
            "message": SOURCE_LIMITATIONS[0],
        })
    else:
        element.note("two_references_not_established", f"Only {valid_count} references are established as qualifying and current; at least two are required.", element.evidence)
        element.problems.add("outstanding")


def evaluate_application(
    ledger: dict[str, Any], application_id: str, revision: str | int, export_date: str | date
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Evaluate the six element states for a specific revision as of an export date."""
    as_of = export_date if isinstance(export_date, date) else _parse_date(export_date)
    if as_of is None:
        raise ValueError("export_date must be a valid YYYY-MM-DD date")
    revision = str(revision)
    rows = _row_records(ledger, as_of)
    app_rows = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "applications.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and str(r.get("values", {}).get("revision")) == revision
    ]
    if not app_rows:
        raise ValueError(f"Application revision {application_id}/{revision} is not present on or before {as_of.isoformat()}")
    app = app_rows[-1][1]["values"]
    first_received_rows = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "applications.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and str(r.get("values", {}).get("revision")) == "1"
    ]
    first_received = _parse_date(first_received_rows[0][1]["values"].get("first_received_date")) if first_received_rows else None
    first_received = first_received or _parse_date(app.get("first_received_date"))
    if first_received is None:
        raise ValueError(f"First-received date is unavailable for {application_id}")

    docs = _doc_index(ledger, as_of, application_id)
    elements = {name: _Element(name) for name in ("licensure", "experience", "gaps", "education", "certification", "references")}
    for batch, record in app_rows:
        for name in elements:
            elements[name].cite(batch, record)

    _license_element(elements["licensure"], rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of, docs)
    _education_experience_elements(elements, rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of, first_received, docs)
    history = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "declared-history.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    _gaps_element(elements["gaps"], history, docs, as_of)
    _certification_element(elements["certification"], rows, app, application_id, revision, first_received, as_of, docs)
    _reference_element(elements["references"], rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of)

    details = {name: element.finish() for name, element in elements.items()}
    return {
        "application_id": application_id,
        "revision": int(revision) if revision.isdigit() else revision,
        "as_of": as_of.isoformat(),
        "elements": {name: details[name]["state"] for name in details},
        "element_details": details,
        "assumptions": [
            "For an undecided file, export_date is used as the reference date for evidence known/current at that export; this is not a committee decision date.",
            "A peer-reference row in peer-reference-replies.csv is treated as a returned office record for eligibility calculations, but the unexported return channel is reported as a limitation.",
        ],
        "unresolved_policy_questions": SOURCE_LIMITATIONS,
    }

def _certification_element(
    element: _Element, rows: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]], app: dict[str, Any],
    application_id: str, revision: str, first_received: date, as_of: date,
    docs: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]],
) -> None:
    declarations = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "declared-credentials.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
        and str(r.get("values", {}).get("credential_class") or "").casefold() in {"certification", "certificate"}
    ]
    history = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "declared-history.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    for b, r in declarations:
        element.cite(b, r)
    replies_by_declaration: dict[str, list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]]] = {}
    for b, r in rows:
        if r.get("filename") == "certification-replies.csv" and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id:
            replies_by_declaration.setdefault(str(r["values"].get("declaration_id") or ""), []).append((b, r))

    verified: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]] = []
    for decl_batch, decl_record in declarations:
        dv = decl_record["values"]
        declaration_id = str(dv.get("declaration_id") or "")
        replies = replies_by_declaration.get(declaration_id, [])
        accepted = []
        for rb, rr in replies:
            rv = rr["values"]
            element.cite(rb, rr)
            received = str(rv.get("received_from") or "").casefold()
            board_code = str(rv.get("board_code") or "").upper()
            accepted_source = received.startswith("certifying board") or any(name in received for name in (
                "abms", "certifacts", "american medical association physician profile",
                "american osteopathic association physician profile", "abps", "ancc", "nccpa",
            ))
            usable, date_reason = _reply_is_usable(rv, first_received, as_of)
            if not accepted_source:
                element.note("inadmissible_certification_source", f"Certification reply source {rv.get('received_from')!r} is not listed in the accepted-source table.", [_source_ref(rb, rr)])
            elif not usable:
                element.note("unusable_certification_date", date_reason, [_source_ref(rb, rr)])
            else:
                accepted.append((rb, rr))
        if not accepted:
            element.note("certification_verification_outstanding", f"No admissible, usable certification reply is on file for declaration {declaration_id!r}.", [_source_ref(decl_batch, decl_record)])
            continue
        responses = {(r["values"].get("certification_status"), r["values"].get("certificate_specialty"), r["values"].get("board_code")) for _, r in accepted}
        if len(responses) > 1:
            element.note("conflicting_certification_replies", f"Admissible replies conflict for declaration {declaration_id!r}; both are retained.", [_source_ref(b, r) for b, r in accepted])
        for rb, rr in accepted:
            rv = rr["values"]
            if str(rv.get("certification_status") or "").casefold() == "not certified":
                element.note("declared_certification_not_confirmed", f"Board reply does not confirm declared certification {declaration_id!r}.", [_source_ref(decl_batch, decl_record), _source_ref(rb, rr)])
            verified.append((rb, rr, dv))

    requests = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "privilege-requests.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    requested_codes = []
    for b, r in requests:
        element.cite(b, r)
        requested_codes.append(str(r["values"].get("privilege_code") or ""))
    if not requested_codes:
        element.note("no_privilege_request", "No privilege group is recorded for this revision; support cannot be evaluated.")
        return

    support: dict[str, str] = {}
    for code in requested_codes:
        criteria = PRIVILEGES.get(code)
        if not criteria:
            support[code] = "unknown"
            element.note("unknown_privilege_code", f"Privilege code {code!r} is absent from the published criteria table.", [_source_ref(b, r) for b, r in requests])
            continue
        code_supported = False
        accreditation_missing = False
        for rb, rr, declaration in verified:
            cert = rr["values"]
            board = str(cert.get("board_code") or "").upper()
            specialty = str(cert.get("certificate_specialty") or "")
            allowed_specialties = criteria["boards"].get(board, set())
            status = str(cert.get("certification_status") or "").casefold()
            active = status == "active"
            eligible = status in {"board eligible", "eligible"}
            if specialty not in allowed_specialties:
                continue
            if not active:
                eligible_allowed = code in {"PRIV-FM", "PRIV-IM", "PRIV-HOSP", "PRIV-PED"}
                expiry = _parse_date(cert.get("expiry_date"))
                notes = str(cert.get("notes") or "").casefold()
                if not (eligible and eligible_allowed and "good standing" in notes and expiry is not None and expiry > as_of):
                    continue
            training_ok, training_evidence, training_accreditation_missing = _training_support(
                criteria["training"], history, rows, application_id, first_received, as_of, docs
            )
            accreditation_missing = accreditation_missing or training_accreditation_missing
            if training_ok:
                code_supported = True
                element.cite(rb, rr)
                for ref in training_evidence:
                    if ref not in element.evidence:
                        element.evidence.append(ref)
                break
        if code_supported:
            support[code] = "supported"
        elif accreditation_missing:
            support[code] = "not-established"
        else:
            support[code] = "unsupported-on-verified-evidence"

    element.observations.append({
        "code": "privilege_support_map",
        "message": "Group support is mapped from verified certification, published board/specialty criteria, and verified training only; current competency is not evaluated.",
        "support_by_privilege": support,
        "evidence": element.evidence.copy(),
    })
    supported = [code for code, value in support.items() if value == "supported"]
    if not supported:
        element.note("threshold_eligibility_question", "No requested group is established as supported by verified evidence at this export date; this raises the documented eligibility question and does not decide it.", element.evidence)
        element.problems.add("eligibility-question")
    elif any(value == "unsupported-on-verified-evidence" for value in support.values()):
        element.note("unsupported_requested_privilege", "One or more requested privilege groups are unsupported on verified evidence; retain the named subset.", element.evidence)
    elif any(value == "not-established" for value in support.values()):
        element.note("privilege_support_not_established", "Accreditation is not present in the available evidence fields for one or more requested groups.", element.evidence)
        element.problems.add("outstanding")


def _reference_element(
    element: _Element, rows: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]], app: dict[str, Any],
    application_id: str, revision: str, as_of: date,
) -> None:
    referees = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "peer-referees.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    replies = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "peer-reference-replies.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
    ]
    for b, r in referees:
        element.cite(b, r)
    discipline = str(app.get("discipline") or "").strip().casefold()
    cutoff = _subtract_years(as_of, 2)
    valid_count = 0
    for referee_batch, referee_record in referees:
        referee = referee_record["values"]
        referee_id = str(referee.get("referee_id") or "")
        matching = [(b, r) for b, r in replies if r["values"].get("referee_id") == referee_id]
        if not matching:
            element.note("reference_outstanding", f"No returned reference is recorded for referee {referee_id!r}.", [_source_ref(referee_batch, referee_record)])
            continue
        for reply_batch, reply_record in matching:
            reply = reply_record["values"]
            element.cite(reply_batch, reply_record)
            signature = _parse_date(reply.get("signature_date"))
            received = _parse_date(reply.get("received_date"))
            if not signature or not received or received > as_of or signature > as_of:
                element.note("reference_date_unusable", f"Reference {referee_id!r} has missing or future signature/received date.", [_source_ref(reply_batch, reply_record)])
                continue
            reasons = []
            last_work = _parse_date(reply.get("last_worked_together_end"))
            if last_work is not None and last_work < _subtract_years(signature, 2):
                reasons.append("direct work ended more than two years before signature")
            stated_discipline = str(reply.get("referee_specialty_stated") or "").strip().casefold()
            if not stated_discipline or stated_discipline != discipline:
                reasons.append("referee discipline does not match the applicant's declared discipline")
            related = str(reply.get("related_or_partner") or "").strip().casefold()
            if related not in {"no", "false"}:
                reasons.append("relationship exclusion is not affirmatively cleared")
            if signature < cutoff:
                reasons.append("signature is older than two years at this export date")
            if reasons:
                element.note("reference_not_countable", f"Reference {referee_id!r} is not countable: " + "; ".join(reasons) + ".", [
                    _source_ref(referee_batch, referee_record), _source_ref(reply_batch, reply_record)
                ])
                continue
            valid_count += 1
    if valid_count >= 2:
        element.observations.append({
            "code": "two_qualifying_current_references",
            "message": f"{valid_count} references satisfy the recorded date, discipline, and relationship checks as of {as_of.isoformat()}.",
            "evidence": element.evidence.copy(),
        })
        element.observations.append({
            "code": "source_channel_not_exported",
            "message": SOURCE_LIMITATIONS[0],
        })
    else:
        element.note("two_references_not_established", f"Only {valid_count} references are established as qualifying and current; at least two are required.", element.evidence)
        element.problems.add("outstanding")


def evaluate_application(
    ledger: dict[str, Any], application_id: str, revision: str | int, export_date: str | date
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Evaluate the six element states for a specific revision as of an export date."""
    as_of = export_date if isinstance(export_date, date) else _parse_date(export_date)
    if as_of is None:
        raise ValueError("export_date must be a valid YYYY-MM-DD date")
    revision = str(revision)
    rows = _row_records(ledger, as_of)
    app_rows = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "applications.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and str(r.get("values", {}).get("revision")) == revision
    ]
    if not app_rows:
        raise ValueError(f"Application revision {application_id}/{revision} is not present on or before {as_of.isoformat()}")
    app = app_rows[-1][1]["values"]
    first_received_rows = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "applications.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and str(r.get("values", {}).get("revision")) == "1"
    ]
    first_received = _parse_date(first_received_rows[0][1]["values"].get("first_received_date")) if first_received_rows else None
    first_received = first_received or _parse_date(app.get("first_received_date"))
    if first_received is None:
        raise ValueError(f"First-received date is unavailable for {application_id}")

    docs = _doc_index(ledger, as_of, application_id)
    elements = {name: _Element(name) for name in ("licensure", "experience", "gaps", "education", "certification", "references")}
    for batch, record in app_rows:
        for name in elements:
            elements[name].cite(batch, record)

    _license_element(elements["licensure"], rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of, docs)
    _education_experience_elements(elements, rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of, first_received, docs)
    history = [
        (b, r) for b, r in rows
        if r.get("filename") == "declared-history.csv"
        and r.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and r.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
    ]
    _gaps_element(elements["gaps"], history, docs, as_of)
    _certification_element(elements["certification"], rows, app, application_id, revision, first_received, as_of, docs)
    _reference_element(elements["references"], rows, app, application_id, revision, as_of)

    details = {name: element.finish() for name, element in elements.items()}
    return {
        "application_id": application_id,
        "revision": int(revision) if revision.isdigit() else revision,
        "as_of": as_of.isoformat(),
        "elements": {name: details[name]["state"] for name in details},
        "element_details": details,
        "assumptions": [
            "For an undecided file, export_date is used as the reference date for evidence known/current at that export; this is not a committee decision date.",
            "A peer-reference row in peer-reference-replies.csv is treated as a returned office record for eligibility calculations, but the unexported return channel is reported as a limitation.",
        ],
        "unresolved_policy_questions": SOURCE_LIMITATIONS,
    }

# Project E rules register

This register records the written hospital rules to implement and separates them from project implementation choices. The seven files under `office/` are the supplied written hospital reference set. When the interview differs from these documents, use the written rule and retain the difference as an unresolved interview conflict; the interview is operational context, not a rule source.

No batch has been processed and no snapshot has been created as part of this stage.

## Source key

| Key | Official document | Version / identifying text |
|---|---|---|
| PROC | `office/procedure-extract.txt` — **Initial appointment — Medical Staff Office procedure** | LARK-MSO-2026.1 |
| PRIV | `office/privilege-criteria.txt` — **Privilege criteria — initial appointment** | LARK-PRIV-2026.1 |
| ATT | `office/attester-table.txt` — **Accepted sources by element — who may attest** | LARK-ATT-2026.1 |
| AUTH | `office/authority-roster.txt` — **Reserved authority — who holds what** | LARK-AUTH-2026.1 |
| APP | `office/application-form.txt` — **Application for initial appointment and clinical privileges — blank form** | LARK-APP-2026.1 |

| EXP | `office/export-notes.txt` — **How this office exports its credentialing records** | Note written 2026-03-16; no version identifier stated |

Section references below use the section numbers and exact headings printed in those files. Where a source has no numbered section, its printed heading, form part, or table name is cited.

## 1. Scope, source authority, and date basis

| Rule | Classification | Authority |

| This workflow covers initial appointment only. Reappointment, additional privileges between appointments, credentialing by proxy, temporary privileges, and emergency or disaster privileges are outside scope. | Written hospital policy | PROC, opening scope paragraph before **“Where our rules come from, and how to tell them apart”** |
| The hospital is non-federal. Implement the Larkhollow rules in the procedure where they tailor or replace federal-facility rules; do not import additional rules from the adopted manual when the procedure does not state them. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **“Where our rules come from, and how to tell them apart”** |
| The export date is…2273 tokens truncated…e verification is available only when the primary/designated equivalent source no longer exists (such as a closed school/programme or dissolved employer), and the reason must be recorded. Non-response is not impossibility. | Written hospital policy | ATT, element tables and **“What to do with a reply that is not on this table”**; PROC, **3. The six checks** |

A later reply does not erase earlier attempts. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **3. The six checks — “How often we ask, and what silence means”** |

## 5. Six verification elements

### 5.1 Licensure

| Rule | Classification | Authority |
|---|---|---|
| Verify every active and inactive medical licence held. Require one current, active, full, unrestricted Washington licence for practice at this hospital. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **Check 1 — Licensure**; APP, **Section G — Licences and certifications** |
| Treat probation, supervision, a monitoring agreement, practice limitation, suspension, stipulated condition, or surrender as a licensure finding. Route the evidence to the Clinical Director; do not judge whether the restriction matters. A disposition ends the hold but does not make the finding disappear. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **Check 1 — Licensure**; AUTH, **Individual authority** |
| A National Provider Identifier is not a licence. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **Check 1 — Licensure**; APP, **Section A — Identity and contact** |
| Initial appointment cycle is one year from effective date through the day before its first anniversary. Licence validity is required on decision date. If Washington licence expiry falls inside the cycle, track re-verification; it does not block initial activation. Record the condition due date as the expiry date. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **Check 1 — Licensure**, **“The cycle”** |
| Board lookup `lookup_date` is the office's own observation, not an external source reply; do not apply the verification usability window to it. A lookup on decision date is usable for that decision. | Written hospital policy | EXP, **“The Washington export's own columns”**; PROC, **8. Packet readiness**, **“The board lookup and the window”** |

### 5.2 Experience

| Rule | Classification | Authority |
|---|---|---|
| Verify relevant work and affiliation history for at least the most recent five years, measured back from first application receipt; go further back for conflicts or suspicious indicators. A later revision does not move that anchor. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **Check 2 — Experience and time gaps** |
| Do not make a current-competency judgment from experience evidence. The procedure assigns current competency to clinical leadership; privilege criteria say current experience travels with the packet and does not make a group unsupported. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **Check 2 — Experience and time gaps**, current-competency boundary; PRIV, **How the office applies the table**, rule 7 |

### 5.3 Time gaps

| Rule | Classification | Authority |
|---|---|---|
| Compute gaps from the day after professional school ends. Treat declared entries as inclusive date ranges; an open end runs through the export date. Overlaps, part-time work, and training cover time. A gap is at least 30 consecutive uncovered days. Recompute the gap set when dates change. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **Check 2 — Experience and time gaps**; APP, **Sections D–F** |
| Record an explanation as covering a gap only if its explicit `Period explained` date range covers the entire computed gap. The office records presence/coverage, not adequacy. An unexplained gap returns the application incomplete. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **Check 2 — Experience and time gaps**; APP, **Section F — Explanation of periods not covered** |
| Route every gap of 180 days or more to the Clinical Director for disposition, whether explained or not. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **Check 2 — Experience and time gaps**; AUTH, **Individual authority** |

### 5.4 Professional education and post-graduate training

| Rule | Classification | Authority |
|---|---|---|
| Verify the qualifying degree and each post-graduate training entry using an admissible source. A degree or training completion is not a licence. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **Check 3 — Professional education and post-graduate training**; APP, **Section D**; ATT, **Education and training** |

### 5.5 Peer references

| Rule | Classification | Authority |
|---|---|---|
| The office sends the form directly to the named referee, who returns it directly. Applicant-carried references cannot be used. | Written hospital policy | REF, opening paragraph; PROC, **Check 4 — Professional peer references** |

The original request remains open/outstanding and never counts. | Written hospital policy | REF, **Part 1 — completed by the Medical Staff Office before sending**; PROC, **Check 4** |
| Two qualifying, current references satisfy the element. An otherwise open request does not hold a met element; retain its action until presentation, then close it as no longer needed. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **Check 4 — Professional peer references** |

### 5.6 Board certification and requested privileges

| Rule | Classification | Authority |

Name unsupported groups individually; do not reject supported groups by association. | Written hospital policy | PRIV, **The twelve privilege groups** and **How the office applies the table**, rules 1–5 |
| Board eligibility substitutes for active certification only for PRIV-FM, PRIV-IM, PRIV-HOSP, and PRIV-PED, with written board confirmation of good standing and a future eligibility end date. It is unavailable for the other listed groups. | Written hospital policy | PRIV, **How the office applies the table**, rule 4 |
| PRIV-CARD requires both the specified cardiology fellowship and preceding internal medicine residency. | Written hospital policy | PRIV, **How the office applies the table**, rule 5 |
| If nothing verified supports any requested group, raise an eligibility question. The Clinical Director alone decides discontinuance. If later evidence supports a requested group, withdraw the question without disposition. | Written hospital policy | PRIV, **How the office applies the table**, rule 6; AUTH, **Individual authority** |
| Do not apply the criteria's current-experience column as an office eligibility test. Current competency is clinical leadership's judgment and travels with the packet. | Written hospital policy | PRIV, **How the office applies the table**, rule 7; PROC, **Reserved judgments** |

High-risk findings** |
