def _license_element(
    element: _Element, rows: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]], app: dict[str, Any],
    application_id: str, revision: str, as_of: date,
    docs: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]],
) -> None:
    identity = tuple(str(app.get(field) or "") for field in ("last_name", "first_name", "middle_name", "birth_year"))
    declared = [
        (batch, record) for batch, record in rows
        if record.get("filename") == "declared-credentials.csv"
        and record.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and record.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
        and str(record.get("values", {}).get("credential_class") or "").casefold() in {"licence", "license"}
    ]
    for batch, record in declared:
        element.cite(batch, record)
    wa_rows = [
        (batch, record) for batch, record in rows
        if record.get("filename") == "licence-lookup-wa.csv"
        and tuple(str(record.get("values", {}).get(field) or "") for field in ("lastname", "firstname", "middlename", "birthyear")) == identity
    ]
    other_rows = [
        (batch, record) for batch, record in rows
        if record.get("filename") == "licence-lookup-other-states.csv"
    ]
    matched: dict[str, list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]]] = {}
    for item in wa_rows:
        number = item[1]["values"].get("credentialnumber")
        if number:
            matched.setdefault(str(number), []).append(item)
    for declared_batch, declared_record in declared:
        dv = declared_record["values"]
        number = str(dv.get("number_declared") or "")
        jurisdiction = str(dv.get("jurisdiction_or_board") or "").upper()
        candidates = matched.get(number, []) if jurisdiction == "WA" else []
        if jurisdiction != "WA":
            candidates = [
                (b, r) for b, r in other_rows
                if str(r.get("values", {}).get("licence_number") or "") == number
                and str(r.get("values", {}).get("board_state") or "").upper() == jurisdiction
            ]
        if not candidates:
            element.note("licence_verification_outstanding", f"No board lookup row is linked to declared licence {number!r} ({jurisdiction}).", [_source_ref(declared_batch, declared_record)])
            continue
        for lookup_batch, lookup_record in candidates:
            lv = lookup_record["values"]
            element.cite(lookup_batch, lookup_record)
            if jurisdiction != "WA":
                verified_by = str(lv.get("verified_by") or "").casefold()
                accepted = ("board" in verified_by and "online verification" in verified_by) or "physician data center" in verified_by
                if not accepted:
                    element.note("inadmissible_license_source", f"Out-of-state licence source {lv.get('verified_by')!r} is not established as a listed board/FSMB source.", [_source_ref(lookup_batch, lookup_record)])
                    continue
            lookup_date = _parse_date(lv.get("lookup_date"))
            if lookup_date is None or lookup_date > as_of:
                element.note("invalid_license_lookup_date", f"Licence lookup date {lv.get('lookup_date')!r} is missing, invalid, or after the export date.", [_source_ref(lookup_batch, lookup_record)])
                continue
            state = str(lv.get("status") or lv.get("license_status") or "").casefold()
            action = str(lv.get("actiontaken") or lv.get("disciplinary_action") or "").casefold()
            action_detail_classified = False
            if action not in {"", "no", "none", "none reported", "false"}:
                if action not in {"yes", "pending", "true"} and any(term in action for term in ("probation", "supervision", "monitoring agreement", "practice limitation", "suspend", "stipulated condition", "surrender", "restriction")):
                    element.note("licensure_finding", f"Board record states an adverse licence condition for {number!r}; preserve and route to the Clinical Director.", [_source_ref(lookup_batch, lookup_record)])
            expiration = _parse_date(lv.get("expirationdate") or lv.get("expiry_date"))
            if jurisdiction == "WA" and (state != "active" or expiration is None or expiration < as_of):
                element.note("washington_license_not_current", f"Washington lookup does not show licence {number!r} as active and unexpired on {as_of.isoformat()}.", [_source_ref(lookup_batch, lookup_record)])
            if jurisdiction == "WA" and any(term in action for term in ("yes", "pending", "stipulated", "probation", "supervision", "restriction")):
                for doc_batch, index_record, document in docs:
                    content = document.get("content", "")
                    if number in content:
                        detail = content.casefold()
                        fields = {k.strip().casefold(): v.strip() for k, v in re.findall(r"^\*\*([^*]+):\*\*[ \t]*(.*?)[ \t]*$", content, re.M)}
                        source_name = fields.get("from", "").casefold()
                        if not any(term in source_name for term in ("washington state department of health", "washington medical commission", "state licensing board")):
                            continue
                        element.cite(doc_batch, index_record, document.get("path"))
                        restrictive = any(term in detail for term in (
                            "stipulated agreement", "under supervision", "monitoring programme", "monitoring program",
                            "practice limitation", "on probation", "suspended", "surrendered", "practice restriction",
                        ))
                        negated = any(phrase in detail for phrase in (
                            "no practice restriction", "no restriction is in force", "not restricted", "no monitoring agreement",
                        ))
                        if restrictive and not negated:
                            action_detail_classified = True
                            element.note("licensure_finding", f"Indexed board document describes a restriction for licence {number!r}; preserve it without judging its significance.", [
                                _source_ref(lookup_batch, lookup_record), _source_ref(doc_batch, index_record, document.get("path"))
                            ])
                        elif negated:
                            action_detail_classified = True
            if action in {"yes", "pending", "true"} and not action_detail_classified:
                element.note("board_action_requires_detail", f"Board lookup indicates action ({action}); an authoritative written board detail classifying the action is not on file.", [_source_ref(lookup_batch, lookup_record)])

    declared_numbers = {str(r[1]["values"].get("number_declared") or "") for r in declared}
    for batch, record in wa_rows:
        number = str(record["values"].get("credentialnumber") or "")
        if number and number not in declared_numbers:
            element.cite(batch, record)
            declared_sources = [_source_ref(b, r) for b, r in declared]
            element.note("undeclared_washington_license", f"Washington lookup contains credential {number!r}, absent from this revision's declared licences.", [_source_ref(batch, record), *declared_sources])

    active_wa = []
    for batch, record in wa_rows:
        values = record["values"]
        expiration = _parse_date(values.get("expirationdate"))
        if str(values.get("status") or "").casefold() == "active" and expiration is not None and expiration >= as_of:
            active_wa.append((batch, record))
    if not active_wa:
        application_sources = [
            _source_ref(batch, record) for batch, record in rows
            if record.get("filename") == "applications.csv"
            and record.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
            and str(record.get("values", {}).get("revision")) == revision
        ]
        element.note("washington_practice_license_missing", "No current active Washington licence is present in the joined board lookup on the export date.", [
            *[_source_ref(batch, record) for batch, record in wa_rows], *application_sources,
        ])
        element.problems.add("finding")

def _add_months(day: date, months: int) -> date:
    month_index = day.month - 1 + months
    year = day.year + month_index // 12
    month = month_index % 12 + 1
    return date(year, month, min(day.day, calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]))

def _license_element(
    element: _Element, rows: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]], app: dict[str, Any],
    application_id: str, revision: str, as_of: date,
    docs: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]],
) -> None:
    identity = tuple(str(app.get(field) or "") for field in ("last_name", "first_name", "middle_name", "birth_year"))
    declared = [
        (batch, record) for batch, record in rows
        if record.get("filename") == "declared-credentials.csv"
        and record.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
        and record.get("values", {}).get("revision") == revision
        and str(record.get("values", {}).get("credential_class") or "").casefold() in {"licence", "license"}
    ]
    for batch, record in declared:
        element.cite(batch, record)
    wa_rows = [
        (batch, record) for batch, record in rows
        if record.get("filename") == "licence-lookup-wa.csv"
        and tuple(str(record.get("values", {}).get(field) or "") for field in ("lastname", "firstname", "middlename", "birthyear")) == identity
    ]
    other_rows = [
        (batch, record) for batch, record in rows
        if record.get("filename") == "licence-lookup-other-states.csv"
    ]
    matched: dict[str, list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]]] = {}
    for item in wa_rows:
        number = item[1]["values"].get("credentialnumber")
        if number:
            matched.setdefault(str(number), []).append(item)
    for declared_batch, declared_record in declared:
        dv = declared_record["values"]
        number = str(dv.get("number_declared") or "")
        jurisdiction = str(dv.get("jurisdiction_or_board") or "").upper()
        candidates = matched.get(number, []) if jurisdiction == "WA" else []
        if jurisdiction != "WA":
            candidates = [
                (b, r) for b, r in other_rows
                if str(r.get("values", {}).get("licence_number") or "") == number
                and str(r.get("values", {}).get("board_state") or "").upper() == jurisdiction
            ]
        if not candidates:
            element.note("licence_verification_outstanding", f"No board lookup row is linked to declared licence {number!r} ({jurisdiction}).", [_source_ref(declared_batch, declared_record)])
            continue
        for lookup_batch, lookup_record in candidates:
            lv = lookup_record["values"]
            element.cite(lookup_batch, lookup_record)
            if jurisdiction != "WA":
                verified_by = str(lv.get("verified_by") or "").casefold()
                accepted = ("board" in verified_by and "online verification" in verified_by) or "physician data center" in verified_by
                if not accepted:
                    element.note("inadmissible_license_source", f"Out-of-state licence source {lv.get('verified_by')!r} is not established as a listed board/FSMB source.", [_source_ref(lookup_batch, lookup_record)])
                    continue
            lookup_date = _parse_date(lv.get("lookup_date"))
            if lookup_date is None or lookup_date > as_of:
                element.note("invalid_license_lookup_date", f"Licence lookup date {lv.get('lookup_date')!r} is missing, invalid, or after the export date.", [_source_ref(lookup_batch, lookup_record)])
                continue
            state = str(lv.get("status") or lv.get("license_status") or "").casefold()
            action = str(lv.get("actiontaken") or lv.get("disciplinary_action") or "").casefold()
            action_detail_classified = False
            if action not in {"", "no", "none", "none reported", "false"}:
                if action not in {"yes", "pending", "true"} and any(term in action for term in ("probation", "supervision", "monitoring agreement", "practice limitation", "suspend", "stipulated condition", "surrender", "restriction")):
                    element.note("licensure_finding", f"Board record states an adverse licence condition for {number!r}; preserve and route to the Clinical Director.", [_source_ref(lookup_batch, lookup_record)])
            expiration = _parse_date(lv.get("expirationdate") or lv.get("expiry_date"))
            if jurisdiction == "WA" and (state != "active" or expiration is None or expiration < as_of):
                element.note("washington_license_not_current", f"Washington lookup does not show licence {number!r} as active and unexpired on {as_of.isoformat()}.", [_source_ref(lookup_batch, lookup_record)])
            if jurisdiction == "WA" and any(term in action for term in ("yes", "pending", "stipulated", "probation", "supervision", "restriction")):
                for doc_batch, index_record, document in docs:
                    content = document.get("content", "")
                    if number in content:
                        detail = content.casefold()
                        fields = {k.strip().casefold(): v.strip() for k, v in re.findall(r"^\*\*([^*]+):\*\*[ \t]*(.*?)[ \t]*$", content, re.M)}
                        source_name = fields.get("from", "").casefold()
                        if not any(term in source_name for term in ("washington state department of health", "washington medical commission", "state licensing board")):
                            continue
                        element.cite(doc_batch, index_record, document.get("path"))
                        restrictive = any(term in detail for term in (
                            "stipulated agreement", "under supervision", "monitoring programme", "monitoring program",
                            "practice limitation", "on probation", "suspended", "surrendered", "practice restriction",
                        ))
                        negated = any(phrase in detail for phrase in (
                            "no practice restriction", "no restriction is in force", "not restricted", "no monitoring agreement",
                        ))
                        if restrictive and not negated:
                            action_detail_classified = True
                            element.note("licensure_finding", f"Indexed board document describes a restriction for licence {number!r}; preserve it without judging its significance.", [
                                _source_ref(lookup_batch, lookup_record), _source_ref(doc_batch, index_record, document.get("path"))
                            ])
                        elif negated:
                            action_detail_classified = True
            if action in {"yes", "pending", "true"} and not action_detail_classified:
                element.note("board_action_requires_detail", f"Board lookup indicates action ({action}); an authoritative written board detail classifying the action is not on file.", [_source_ref(lookup_batch, lookup_record)])

    declared_numbers = {str(r[1]["values"].get("number_declared") or "") for r in declared}
    for batch, record in wa_rows:
        number = str(record["values"].get("credentialnumber") or "")
        if number and number not in declared_numbers:
            element.cite(batch, record)
            declared_sources = [_source_ref(b, r) for b, r in declared]
            element.note("undeclared_washington_license", f"Washington lookup contains credential {number!r}, absent from this revision's declared licences.", [_source_ref(batch, record), *declared_sources])

    active_wa = []
    for batch, record in wa_rows:
        values = record["values"]
        expiration = _parse_date(values.get("expirationdate"))
        if str(values.get("status") or "").casefold() == "active" and expiration is not None and expiration >= as_of:
            active_wa.append((batch, record))
    if not active_wa:
        application_sources = [
            _source_ref(batch, record) for batch, record in rows
            if record.get("filename") == "applications.csv"
            and record.get("values", {}).get("application_id") == application_id
            and str(record.get("values", {}).get("revision")) == revision
        ]
        element.note("washington_practice_license_missing", "No current active Washington licence is present in the joined board lookup on the export date.", [
            *[_source_ref(batch, record) for batch, record in wa_rows], *application_sources,
        ])
        element.problems.add("finding")

def _add_months(day: date, months: int) -> date:
    month_index = day.month - 1 + months
    year = day.year + month_index // 12
    month = month_index % 12 + 1
    return date(year, month, min(day.day, calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]))

def _add_months(day: date, months: int) -> date:
    month_index = day.month - 1 + months
    year = day.year + month_index // 12
    month = month_index % 12 + 1
    return date(year, month, min(day.day, calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]))

Check 3 — Professional education and post-graduate training
The manual, Section 6, Subsection 4, element 2:
"A qualifying degree is the degree required for the applicant's position and privileges."
"such as internship, residency, fellowship, or other organized professional training will be verified."
So: the qualifying degree, and every post-graduate training entry. The accepted sources are in attester-table.md. The admissibility rules are the ones in "What counts as a verification at all" above — the applicant may not carry the reply, and a source not on the table is raised.
The manual also states the boundary this check does not cross, Section 6, Subsection 4, element 2:
"obtaining a degree and postgraduate training does not automatically confer a license to practice"
Check 4 — Professional peer references
The manual, Section 6, Subsection 4, element 11:
"IHS policy requires the collection of at least two peer references at the initial appointment. The"
"All peer references are from a professional authority who has worked directly with the applicant within the past two years and can authoritatively speak to the applicant's character, clinical experience, and competency."
"the IHS definition of a peer includes a practitioner in the same clinical discipline."
"A peer must not be a relative, spouse, or partner."
Three disqualifiers, each independent: not worked together directly inside two years; not in the same clinical discipline; a relative, spouse or partner. A referee who fails any one of them does not count, and we find out only when the reply arrives and states the relationship.
Larkhollow rule — how each of the three is measured. The manual gives the conditions and not the arithmetic, so ours is:
* Worked together within two years is measured against the date the referee signs, because that is the day the referee attests to it. A referee whose last date working directly with the applicant is earlier than two years before their own signature date does not qualify. A blank last date means they still work together and the condition holds.
* Same clinical discipline is the discipline the referee states on the returned form against the discipline the applicant declared on the application. Both come from a fixed list.
* Relative, spouse or partner is the box the referee ticks on the returned form, read with whatever they wrote beside it.
Currency, from Section 8:
"Peer references are considered current if the reference's signature is within two years of the file presentation to the GB."
The signature date, not the date we received it. A reference can go stale while the file waits.
Larkhollow rule — when currency is measured. A reference is current when the presentation date is on or before the second anniversary of the signature date. For a file the Governing Body has decided, the presentation date is the decision date. For a file not yet decided, we measure currency against today, so that a reference about to go stale is visible before the committee meets rather than afterwards.
Larkhollow rule — the reference window. The manual states how many times to ask and does not state how long to wait. Ours: 21 calendar days per request, up to three requests. Request one goes out, request two 21 days later, request three 21 days after that. From day 64 after the first request the reference is overdue: we tell the applicant and ask for an additional referee. The original request stays open and stays outstanding; it is never closed as satisfied and never counted.

"A qualifying degree is the degree required for the applicant's position and privileges."
"such as internship, residency, fellowship, or other organized professional training will be verified."
So: the qualifying degree, and every post-graduate training entry. The accepted sources are in attester-table.md. The admissibility rules are the ones in "What counts as a verification at all" above — the applicant may not carry the reply, and a source not on the table is raised.
The manual also states the boundary this check does not cross, Section 6, Subsection 4, element 2:

Check 4 — Professional peer references
The manual, Section 6, Subsection 4, element 11:
"IHS policy requires the collection of at least two peer references at the initial appointment. The"
"All peer references are from a professional authority who has worked directly with the applicant within the past two years and can authoritatively speak to the applicant's character, clinical experience, and competency."
"the IHS definition of a peer includes a practitioner in the same clinical discipline."
"A peer must not be a relative, spouse, or partner."
Three disqualifiers, each independent: not worked together directly inside two years; not in the same clinical discipline; a relative, spouse or partner. A referee who fails any one of them does not count, and we find out only when the reply arrives and states the relationship.

* Worked together within two years is measured against the date the referee signs, because that is the day the referee attests to it. A referee whose last date working directly with the applicant is earlier than two years before their own signature date does not qualify. A blank last date means they still work together and the condition holds.
* Same clinical discipline is the discipline the referee states on the returned form against the discipline the applicant declared on the application. Both come from a fixed list.
* Relative, spouse or partner is the box the referee ticks on the returned form, read with whatever they wrote beside it.
Currency, from Section 8:
"Peer references are considered current if the reference's signature is within two years of the file presentation to the GB."
The signature date, not the date we received it. A reference can go stale while the file waits.
Larkhollow rule — when currency is measured. A reference is current when the presentation date is on or before the second anniversary of the signature date. For a file the Governing Body has decided, the presentation date is the decision date. For a file not yet decided, we measure currency against today, so that a reference about to go stale is visible before the committee meets rather than afterwards.
Larkhollow rule — the reference window. The manual states how many times to ask and does not state how long to wait. Ours: 21 calendar days per request, up to three requests. Request one goes out, request two 21 days later, request three 21 days after that. From day 64 after the first request the reference is overdue: we tell the applicant and ask for an additional referee. The original request stays open and stays outstanding; it is never closed as satisfied and never counted.

./snapshot.schema.json:163:          "description": "The file's state at this export date. intake-incomplete — an item on the completeness list is missing, has been requested in writing, and the applicant's clock is running. returned-incomplete — the file was returned to the applicant as incomplete. ineligible-clock-expired — the applicant's clock ran out with the requested item still missing. in-verification — the file is complete and at least one element is not resolved. packet-presentable — every element is resolved, the packet is bound to this revision, and no admitted outcome governs it yet. decision-inadmissible — a decision record for this file was refused and no admitted Governing Body outcome governs this revision. deferred — an admitted Governing Body deferral is outstanding. denied — an admitted Governing Body denial is on file. approved-not-yet-effective — an approval is admitted and its privileges start after this export date. active — the approved privileges are active on this export date. active-with-conditions — active, with at least one monitored condition still running. withdrawn — the applicant withdrew the application. discontinued — the Clinical Director discontinued it. Precedence when more than one description fits a file at an export date: a terminal status (withdrawn, discontinued) governs everything; otherwise an intake status (intake-incomplete, returned-incomplete, ineligible-clock-expired) governs whenever a completeness item is missing; otherwise the status furthest along this order governs: in-verification, packet-presentable, decision-inadmissible, deferred, denied, approved-not-yet-effective, active or active-with-conditions.",
./deliverables/rules.md:56:| The export omits referee working addresses. Mark completeness condition 7's address check as not assessable from the export, neither met nor failed; do not fabricate an address or infer a pass. | Written hospital policy | EXP, **“What I do not export”** |
./deliverables/rules.md:143:| Validate a decision using all five written conditions: authorized body/outcome; signatory held role on decision date; correct applicant and revision; presentable packet existed before decision date; valid outcome and required reason. Valid outcomes are approved, approved-with-conditions, deferred-pending-information, denied, recommended, and not-recommended. Plain approval and positive recommendation carry no reason; approval-with-conditions, deferral, denial, and not-recommended require one. Do not accept a decision's own assertion of authority as proof. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **9. The committee protocol**, **“what makes a decision admissible”** and **“which outcomes carry a reason”**; AUTH, **Who may record what** and opening authority statement |
./deliverables/rules.md:144:| A decision against a superseded revision remains history and cannot authorize the current revision. A second Governing Body decision for the same revision must identify the earlier decision it supersedes; otherwise it is inadmissible. Keep refused records and reasons. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **9. The committee protocol**, rules on superseded revisions and two decisions; AUTH, **Who may record what** |
./deliverables/rules.md:148:| Re-enter work for a new revision, new evidence/reclassification/corrected date, credential expiry/renewal, inadmissible or superseded decision, withdrawal, or discontinuance. Reopen only the affected work as specified and retain every prior occurrence. | Written hospital policy | PROC, **11. Re-entry: when something lands on work already done** |

./credentialing/readiness.py:1:"""Packet readiness, recorded-decision admission, and activation.
./credentialing/readiness.py:43:    # to travel with a presentable packet; it is not an open verification hold.
./credentialing/readiness.py:270:    # The record must have a presentable packet before its decision date.
./interviews/project-e-practitioner-credentialing-20261012-1308.md:247:A decision is admissible when five conditions are met: the body recording it has the authority, the signatory held the named role per the authority roster, it names the correct applicant and application revision, a presentable packet existed for that revision, and the outcome is a valid type with the required reasons.
./interviews/project-e-practitioner-credentialing-20261012-1308.md:309:Once the presentable packet is complete, I present it to the Executive Committee of the Medical Staff for recommendations, and then to the Governing Body for final approval.
./interviews/project-e-practitioner-credentialing-20261012-1308.md:731:Intake Incomplete triggers when any of the nine conditions are not met during the completeness screen. Returned Incomplete occurs when the 30-day clock expires without a response. Ineligible and Clock Expired are terminal outcomes tied to those missing replies. In Verification triggers once the signed release is on file. Packet Presentable is reached when all elements are resolved and within the usability window. Decision records an outcome from the committees, while Inadmissible marks a decision that fails validation. Deferred pauses processing while awaiting information, Denied concludes the process negatively, Approved is a positive final decision, Not Yet Effective holds activation for a future date, Active indicates privileges are live, Active with Conditions tracks ongoing requirements, Withdrawn is chosen by the applicant, and Discontinued is determined by the Clinical Director.
./interviews/project-e-practitioner-credentialing-20261012-1308.md:755:And what happens when an earlier approval, deferral, or inadmissible decision remains in the record while a new revision or decision arrives?
./interviews/project-e-practitioner-credentialing-20261012-1308.md:759:When a new revision or admissible decision arrives, the earlier decision record is preserved in the file as history and is never deleted. It remains tied specifically to the revision it named, ensuring nothing is overwritten.

./interviews/project-e-practitioner-credentialing-20261012-1308.md:247:A decision is admissible when five conditions are met: the body recording it has the authority, the signatory held the named role per the authority roster, it names the correct applicant and application revision, a presentable packet existed for that revision, and the outcome is a valid type with the required reasons.
./interviews/project-e-practitioner-credentialing-20261012-1308.md:309:Once the presentable packet is complete, I present it to the Executive Committee of the Medical Staff for recommendations, and then to the Governing Body for final approval.
./interviews/project-e-practitioner-credentialing-20261012-1308.md:731:Intake Incomplete triggers when any of the nine conditions are not met during the completeness screen. Returned Incomplete occurs when the 30-day clock expires without a response. Ineligible and Clock Expired are terminal outcomes tied to those missing replies. In Verification triggers once the signed release is on file. Packet Presentable is reached when all elements are resolved and within the usability window. Decision records an outcome from the committees, while Inadmissible marks a decision that fails validation. Deferred pauses processing while awaiting information, Denied concludes the process negatively, Approved is a positive final decision, Not Yet Effective holds activation for a future date, Active indicates privileges are live, Active with Conditions tracks ongoing requirements, Withdrawn is chosen by the applicant, and Discontinued is determined by the Clinical Director.
./interviews/project-e-practitioner-credentialing-20261012-1308.md:755:And what happens when an earlier approval, deferral, or inadmissible decision remains in the record while a new revision or decision arrives?
./interviews/project-e-practitioner-credentialing-20261012-1308.md:759:When a new revision or admissible decision arrives, the earlier decision record is preserved in the file as history and is never deleted. It remains tied specifically to the revision it named, ensuring nothing is overwritten.

item.stdout:
How often we ask, and what silence means
The manual, Section 6, Subsection 2:
"Verifications are attempted at least three times."
"Each attempt, including whom it was attempted to verify with, the date of request, verification methods, and any additional comments, is documented in the Notes section of the entry."
"Note that non-responsive individuals or entities may be a red flag."
And Section 15, on affiliations:
"If the affiliation is unwilling to complete the verification or is non-responsive after 3 attempts, this should be noted as a red flag."
Larkhollow rule. The attempt log is permanent. A reply arriving on the fourth attempt does not erase the three that went unanswered — the record of how hard the file was to verify is part of the file. Silence is never a pass. An unanswered request is an outstanding item for as long as it stays unanswered.
Check 1 — Licensure
The manual, Section 6, Subsection 4, element 6:
"At the initial appointment, all active and inactive professional medical licenses will be verified."
"Licenses will be verified before expiration."
and, on what a licence has to be:
"Every licensed practitioner who provides patient care in federal facilities must possess a current, active, full, and unrestricted license or registration from a State, the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, or a territory of the United States."
Larkhollow rule — the practice state. The manual's sentence above is a federal facility's rule: it accepts a licence from any State, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico or a territory, and Section 15 says so again, answering the question "Where is it documented that a practitioner does not need to be licensed in the state where they provide services in a federal facility?" with
"Federal law at 25 U.S.C. § 1621t states that licensed health professionals employed by a tribal health program are exempt if licensed in any state, from the licensure requirements of the state where services under an ISDEAA agreement are performed."
We are not a federal facility and that exemption does not reach us. Larkhollow's bylaws require a practitioner to hold one current, active, full and unrestricted licence issued by the State of Washington, which is our practice state. Every other licence the applicant holds, active or inactive, in any state, is still verified under the manual's sentence above — we verify them all; only one of them satisfies the bylaw.
Larkhollow rule — full and unrestricted. A licence is not full and unrestricted when the board's record or the board's reply shows probation, supervision, a monitoring agreement, a practice limitation, a suspension, a stipulated condition or a surrender. A licence in any of those states is a finding and goes to the Clinical Director with its evidence. It is not the office's judgment whether the restriction matters.
The element's state is finding from the day the restriction is seen and stays finding on every later record of that revision, including after the Clinical Director's disposition ends the hold on the file. The disposition ends the wait; it does not turn a finding into a clean element. resolved is for an element with nothing to weigh.
Larkhollow rule — a National Provider Identifier is not a licence. It identifies a practitioner for billing. It says nothing about whether anybody is licensed. An applicant who declares an identifier in place of a licence has declared no licence.
Larkhollow rule — the cycle. An initial appointment at Larkhollow runs one year, matching the manual's Section 12:
"For IHS, initial appointments are one year long, and reappointments are two years long, regardless of accrediting body medical staff standards or medical staff bylaws."
The cycle starts on the date the appointment takes effect and ends one year later minus one day, so a cycle starting 2026-05-01 ends 2027-04-30. The Washington licence must be valid on the decision date. If it expires inside the cycle, that is not a denial and it is not a pass: it is recorded as a monitored condition with a re-verification due date set before the expiry date, and it does not block activation. If the re-verification fails, the file re-opens. The due date recorded on the condition is the licence's expiry date itself; "before" says when the re-verification must be complete, not what the recorded date is.
Check 2 — Experience and time gaps
The manual, Section 6, Subsection 4, element 3:
"At the initial appointment, relevant experience (affiliations, work history, and military) for at least the most recent five years for work history and the most recent five years for affiliation history"
"or as far back as necessary per any conflicting information or suspicious indicators—to assess current competency is verified."
Five years is a floor, not a ceiling. Conflicting information takes us further back.
Larkhollow rule — where the five years are measured from. The manual states the window and not its anchor. Ours is the date the application was first received: an entry is inside the window when any part of it falls in the five years counted back from the date the application was first received. A later revision does not move the anchor.
Element 4 defines a gap and says what is owed:
"A time gap is 30 or more days when the LP is not in school or training, in the military, teaching, working,"
"Verification of time gaps is not required, but an explanation is."
Larkhollow rule — how the gap list is computed. The clock starts on the day after the applicant finished professional school. Every declared entry of any type covers every day from its start date to its end date inclusive; an entry with no end date runs to the export date. Overlapping entries, part-time appointments and training years are covering entries: an overlap covers, it does not create a gap. A gap is a run of 30 or more consecutive days that no entry covers. The list is recomputed from scratch whenever a revision or a verification changes a date; it is not patched.
Larkhollow rule — what the office does with a gap. We record the gap and we record the applicant's written explanation beside it. An explanation names the period it covers, and it covers a gap only when that named period runs from at or before the gap's first day to at or after the gap's last day. A gap with a written explanation covering it is marked explained. A gap with no written explanation is unexplained, and the application is returned as incomplete under the manual's sentence quoted in section 1. The office marks a gap explained on the presence of a written explanation and on nothing else. We do not read the explanation and decide whether it is good enough. The manual, Section 6, Subsection 4, element 8:
"current competency is determined by clinical leadership, not the MSP."
Larkhollow rule — the long gap. Any gap of 180 days or more is routed to the Clinical Director for a recorded disposition, whether or not it carries an explanation. The Clinical Director decides; the office supplies the gap, the explanation and the verified dates.
Check 3 — Professional education and post-graduate training
The manual, Section 6, Subsection 4, element 2:
"A qualifying degree is the degree required for the applicant's position and privileges."
"such as internship, residency, fellowship, or other organized professional training will be verified."
So: the qualifying degree, and every post-graduate training entry. The accepted sources are in attester-table.md. The admissibility rules are the ones in "What counts as a verification at all" above — the applicant may not carry the reply, and a source not on the table is raised.
The manual also states the boundary this check does not cross, Section 6, Subsection 4, element 2:
"obtaining a degree and postgraduate training does not automatically confer a license to practice"
Check 4 — Professional peer references
The manual, Section 6, Subsection 4, element 11:
"IHS policy requires the collection of at least two peer references at the initial appointment. The"
"All peer references are from a professional authority who has worked directly with the applicant within the past two years and can authoritatively speak to the applicant's character, clinical experience, and competency."

How often we ask, and what silence means
The manual, Section 6, Subsection 2:
"Verifications are attempted at least three times."
"Each attempt, including whom it was attempted to verify with, the date of request, verification methods, and any additional comments, is documented in the Notes section of the entry."
"Note that non-responsive individuals or entities may be a red flag."
And Section 15, on affiliations:
"If the affiliation is unwilling to complete the verification or is non-responsive after 3 attempts, this should be noted as a red flag."
Larkhollow rule. The attempt log is permanent. A reply arriving on the fourth attempt does not erase the three that went unanswered — the record of how hard the file was to verify is part of the file. Silence is never a pass. An unanswered request is an outstanding item for as long as it stays unanswered.
Check 1 — Licensure
The manual, Section 6, Subsection 4, element 6:
"At the initial appointment, all active and inactive professional medical licenses will be verified."
"Licenses will be verified before expiration."
and, on what a licence has to be:
"Every licensed practitioner who provides patient care in federal facilities must possess a current, active, full, and unrestricted license or registration from a State, the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, or a territory of the United States."
Larkhollow rule — the practice state. The manual's sentence above is a federal facility's rule: it accepts a licence from any State, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico or a territory, and Section 15 says so again, answering the question "Where is it documented that a practitioner does not need to be licensed in the state where they provide services in a federal facility?" with
"Federal law at 25 U.S.C. § 1621t states that licensed health professionals employed by a tribal health program are exempt if licensed in any state, from the licensure requirements of the state where services under an ISDEAA agreement are performed."
We are not a federal facility and that exemption does not reach us. Larkhollow's bylaws require a practitioner to hold one current, active, full and unrestricted licence issued by the State of Washington, which is our practice state. Every other licence the applicant holds, active or inactive, in any state, is still verified under the manual's sentence above — we verify them all; only one of them satisfies the bylaw.
Larkhollow rule — full and unrestricted. A licence is not full and unrestricted when the board's record or the board's reply shows probation, supervision, a monitoring agreement, a practice limitation, a suspension, a stipulated condition or a surrender. The element's state is finding from the day the restriction is seen and stays finding on every later record of that revision, including after the Clinical Director's disposition ends the hold on the file. The disposition ends the wait; it does not turn a finding into a clean element. resolved is for an element with nothing to weigh.
Larkhollow rule — a National Provider Identifier is not a licence. It identifies a practitioner for billing. It says nothing about whether anybody is licensed. An applicant who declares an identifier in place of a licence has declared no licence.

"For IHS, initial appointments are one year long, and reappointments are two years long, regardless of accrediting body medical staff standards or medical staff bylaws."

﻿Privilege criteria — initial appointment
Larkhollow Community Hospital · Medical Staff Office Criteria version LARK-PRIV-2026.1, in force from 2026-01-01. Set by the Clinical Director with the Executive Committee of the Medical Staff. Published and applied by the Medical Staff Office. The office applies these criteria; the office does not write them and does not extend them for an individual applicant.
Every decision record cites the criteria version it was decided under. A file decided under one version is not re-read under another; a new version re-opens the mapping for files not yet decided.
The manual we adopted says what criteria must cover, in Section 9: "At a minimum, privilege criteria should address the required education level, formal training requirements, and current experience." The three columns below are those three.
The twelve privilege groups
Every group requires a Doctor of Medicine or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine degree from an accredited school, so the education level is not repeated in each row.

	PRIV-IM
	Internal Medicine — outpatient and inpatient care of adults

## Findings

The audit found **one demonstrable evaluator bug**. For application revision 2, the evaluator discarded referee nominations made on revision 1. The export notes say which records are restated on each revision and do not include referee nominations in that list; the procedure also allows unaffected verification to carry forward. I changed the evaluator to retain earlier nominations and recheck their eligibility and currency, and added a regression test.

That fixes a false “zero qualifying references” result for GBD-2026-035. It **does not** make that decision admissible: its packet still has other unresolved requirements.

## Representative decisions

| Decision | Recorded authority and terms | Evaluator result and remaining blockers |
|---|---|---|
| [GBD-2026-011](</home/maxg/practitioner-credentialing/inputs/Batch 2 export — 2026-04-20/decisions/2026-04-14_GBD-2026-011.md>) | Governing Body approval by Vice-Chair Desmond Ihejirika on 2026-04-14, for APP-2026-001 revision 1, effective 2026-05-01. His roster designation authorized him to record approvals in 2026. | Not admitted: the evaluator could not establish a presentable packet. The current-employment reply for ENT-0103 (VR-0103) confirms the role and start date, but `verified_to` is blank. Degree and residency replies VR-0100/VR-0101 do not state accreditation. RR-0100/RR-0101 meet the recorded reference date, discipline, and relationship checks, but the export does not record how the forms were returned. |
| [GBD-2026-039](</home/maxg/practitioner-credentialing/inputs/Batch 2 export — 2026-04-20/decisions/2026-04-14_GBD-2026-039.md>) | Authorized conditional approval for APP-2026-039 revision 1, effective 2026-05-01. The parser now reads both conditions and their due dates from the document’s `Conditions` list. | Not admitted for the same types of unresolved packet evidence: current-employment reply VR-3903 has blank `verified_to`; the education replies do not establish accreditation; RR-3900/RR-3901 do not establish the return channel. The future Clinical Director concurrence is recorded as an approval condition; it was not the evaluator’s rejection reason. |
| [GBD-2026-035](</home/maxg/practitioner-credentialing/inputs/Batch 3 export — 2026-05-18/decisions/2026-05-12_GBD-2026-035.md>) | Authorized approval for APP-2026-036 revision 2, effective 2026-06-01, explicitly superseding GBD-2026-034. | Not admitted because the packet was not established as presentable. The newly carried-forward RR-3600/RR-3601 replies now count as qualifying and current; their direct-return channel remains unrecorded. Current-employment reply VR-3603 still has blank `verified_to`; the education replies do not state accreditation. VR-3604, received before this decision, verifies the revised ENT-3602 history dates and employer. |

The revision-2 reference correction is in [evaluation.py](/home/maxg/practitioner-credentialing/credentialing/evaluation.py), with the regression test in [test_evaluation.py](/home/maxg/practitioner-credentialing/tests/test_evaluation.py).

## What the export does and does not establish

- **Accreditation:** The privilege criteria require an accredited medical school and training program. The supplied verification rows establish credentials and dates but do not establish accreditation for these cases. This is **missing evidence that the export format could have carried**—for example, in the reply notes—but it is not evidence that the schools were unaccredited. The evaluator conservatively leaves education and privilege support unresolved.
- **Reference return channel:** The peer-reference form requires direct office-to-referee sending and direct return. The reply rows establish that completed forms were received, but no supplied field or indexed document identifies the return route. This requirement is **not assessable from these exports**. The export notes explicitly make only the referee-address check unassessable, “neither met nor failed”; they do not specify how to handle an unrecorded return route.
- **Blank verification end dates:** The export notes define a blank `declared-history.to_date` as current through the export date. They do not assign that meaning to `verification-replies.verified_to`; their general rule says an empty cell means no value is held. These replies therefore do not establish a verified end date. The source could have populated that field, so this is **missing source evidence**, not proof that the employment ended. The procedure requires relevant experience verification, but does not separately say that every current employment reply must contain an end date; that exact boundary remains unclear.

The local README links the full assignment instructions, but that Google document was inaccessible in this environment and no local copy was present. The local snapshot schema provides states such as `resolved` and `outstanding`, and requires an admission boolean; it defines no unassessable state or rule for whether an unassessable criterion invalidates admission. The export notes give a specific neither-met-nor-failed rule for addresses, but no general rule covering accreditation or reference-return channel. I have not extended that exception to other requirements.

**Therefore, the three decisions remain unadmitted by the evaluator’s conservative evidence check, but the export does not prove that the hospital’s human decisions were invalid.** I did not mark unknown evidence as verified or invent an admission exception.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate a credentialing batch snapshot against the repository schema."""

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, FormatChecker
from jsonschema.exceptions import SchemaError


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Validate a snapshot JSON file against snapshot.schema.json."
    )
    parser.add_argument("snapshot", type=Path, help="path to the snapshot JSON file")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    schema_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "snapshot.schema.json"
    try:
        with schema_path.open(encoding="utf-8") as schema_file:
            schema = json.load(schema_file)
        with args.snapshot.open(encoding="utf-8") as snapshot_file:
            snapshot = json.load(snapshot_file)
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        print(f"Error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    try:
        validator = Draft202012Validator(
            schema, format_checker=FormatChecker()
        )
        errors = sorted(validator.iter_errors(snapshot), key=lambda error: list(map(str, error.absolute_path)))
    except SchemaError as exc:
        print(f"Error: invalid schema at {schema_path}: {exc.message}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    if errors:
        print(f"Invalid snapshot: {args.snapshot}", file=sys.stderr)
        for error in errors:
            location = ".".join(str(part) for part in error.absolute_path) or "$"
            print(f"  {location}: {error.message}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    print(f"Valid snapshot: {args.snapshot}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Ingest one closed Project E batch into an append-only evidence ledger."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from credentialing.ingestion import empty_ledger, ingest_batch, load_ledger


def save_ledger(path: Path, ledger: dict) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    descriptor, temporary_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", suffix=".tmp", dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as output:
            json.dump(ledger, output, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            output.write("\n")
            output.flush()
            os.fsync(output.fileno())
        os.replace(temporary_name, path)
    except BaseException:
        try:
            os.unlink(temporary_name)
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Ingest a batch export without applying credentialing decisions.")
    parser.add_argument("batch_dir", type=Path, help="directory containing one batch README, CSVs, and indexed documents")
    parser.add_argument("--ledger", type=Path, help="existing evidence ledger to merge into")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, help="ledger output path (defaults to --ledger, or deliverables/evidence-ledger.json)")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    try:
        current = load_ledger(args.ledger) if args.ledger else empty_ledger()
        result = ingest_batch(args.batch_dir, current)
        output_path = args.output or args.ledger or Path("deliverables/evidence-ledger.json")
        if result.changed:
            save_ledger(output_path, result.ledger)
        elif args.ledger is None and result.batch_id is None:
            # A new run with an unreadable README has nothing safe to serialize.
            pass
    except (OSError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        print(f"Ingestion failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    if result.changed:
        print(f"Ingested {result.batch_id} into {output_path}")
    else:
        print(f"No ledger changes for {result.batch_id or args.batch_dir}")
    for issue in result.issues:
        location = issue.filename or "batch"
        if issue.row_number is not None:
            location += f":{issue.row_number}"
        print(f"{issue.code} [{location}]: {issue.message}", file=sys.stderr)
    return 1 if result.issues else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate a credentialing batch snapshot against the repository schema."""

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, FormatChecker
from jsonschema.exceptions import SchemaError


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Validate a snapshot JSON file against snapshot.schema.json."
    )
    parser.add_argument("snapshot", type=Path, help="path to the snapshot JSON file")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    schema_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "snapshot.schema.json"
    try:
        with schema_path.open(encoding="utf-8") as schema_file:
            schema = json.load(schema_file)
        with args.snapshot.open(encoding="utf-8") as snapshot_file:
            snapshot = json.load(snapshot_file)
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        print(f"Error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    try:
        validator = Draft202012Validator(
            schema, format_checker=FormatChecker()
        )
        errors = sorted(validator.iter_errors(snapshot), key=lambda error: list(map(str, error.absolute_path)))
    except SchemaError as exc:
        print(f"Error: invalid schema at {schema_path}: {exc.message}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    if errors:
        print(f"Invalid snapshot: {args.snapshot}", file=sys.stderr)
        for error in errors:
            location = ".".join(str(part) for part in error.absolute_path) or "$"
            print(f"  {location}: {error.message}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    print(f"Valid snapshot: {args.snapshot}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Ingest one closed Project E batch into an append-only evidence ledger."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from credentialing.ingestion import empty_ledger, ingest_batch, load_ledger


def save_ledger(path: Path, ledger: dict) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    descriptor, temporary_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", suffix=".tmp", dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as output:
            json.dump(ledger, output, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            output.write("\n")
            output.flush()
            os.fsync(output.fileno())
        os.replace(temporary_name, path)
    except BaseException:
        try:
            os.unlink(temporary_name)
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Ingest a batch export without applying credentialing decisions.")
    parser.add_argument("batch_dir", type=Path, help="directory containing one batch README, CSVs, and indexed documents")
    parser.add_argument("--ledger", type=Path, help="existing evidence ledger to merge into")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, help="ledger output path (defaults to --ledger, or deliverables/evidence-ledger.json)")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    try:
        current = load_ledger(args.ledger) if args.ledger else empty_ledger()
        result = ingest_batch(args.batch_dir, current)
        output_path = args.output or args.ledger or Path("deliverables/evidence-ledger.json")
        if result.changed:
            save_ledger(output_path, result.ledger)
        elif args.ledger is None and result.batch_id is None:
            # A new run with an unreadable README has nothing safe to serialize.
            pass
    except (OSError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        print(f"Ingestion failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    if result.changed:
        print(f"Ingested {result.batch_id} into {output_path}")
    else:
        print(f"No ledger changes for {result.batch_id or args.batch_dir}")
    for issue in result.issues:
        location = issue.filename or "batch"
        if issue.row_number is not None:
            location += f":{issue.row_number}"
        print(f"{issue.code} [{location}]: {issue.message}", file=sys.stderr)
    return 1 if result.issues else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, FormatChecker

class SnapshotGeneratorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=".snapshot-generator-test-", dir=ROOT)
        self.work = Path(self.temp.name)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def test_schema_chain_rerun_and_revision_history(self):
        output = self.work / "snapshots"
        created = generate_snapshots(source_batches(), output)
        snapshots = sorted(output.glob("snapshot-batch-*.json"))
        self.assertEqual(len(snapshots), 3)
        self.assertEqual(len([p for p in created if p.name.startswith("snapshot-")]), 3)

        schema = json.loads((ROOT / "snapshot.schema.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        validator = Draft202012Validator(schema, format_checker=FormatChecker())
        contents = [p.read_bytes() for p in snapshots]
        decoded = [json.loads(data) for data in contents]
        for snapshot in decoded:
            validator.validate(snapshot)
        self.assertIsNone(decoded[0]["predecessor"])
        for index in (1, 2):
            predecessor = decoded[index]["predecessor"]
            self.assertEqual(predecessor["path"], snapshots[index - 1].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
            self.assertEqual(predecessor["sha256"], sha256(contents[index - 1]).hexdigest())

        app1 = next(a for a in decoded[0]["applications"] if a["application_id"] == "APP-2026-036")
        app2 = next(a for a in decoded[1]["applications"] if a["application_id"] == "APP-2026-036")
        self.assertEqual(app1["revision"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(app2["revision"], 2)
        ledger2 = json.loads((output / "evidence-ledger-batch-02.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        app_revisions = {
            r["values"]["revision"] for b in ledger2["batches"] for r in b["records"]
            if r["filename"] == "applications.csv" and r["values"].get("application_id") == "APP-2026-036"
        }

        self.assertEqual(generate_snapshots(source_batches(), output), [])
        self.assertEqual(mtimes, {p: p.stat().st_mtime_ns for p in output.rglob("*") if p.is_file()})

        for snapshot in decoded:
            for app in snapshot["applications"]:
                admitted = {d["decision_id"] for d in app["decisions"] if d["admitted"]}

        self.assertEqual(generate_snapshots(
            batches, output, correction_id="fixture-correction-1", correction_note="Test corrected source digest handling."

The generator processes the three exports in order, evaluates each at its own export date, and writes a cumulative evidence-ledger checkpoint alongside each snapshot. The checkpoints preserve earlier source rows and revisions; each snapshot contains the latest revision per application and all recorded decisions through that batch. Follow-up items cite source batch, file, row, or document where available. Missing and unassessable evidence remains unresolved.

Each snapshot is validated against the unchanged schema and links to its predecessor’s repository-relative path and SHA-256. An identical rerun makes no file changes. Conflicting output is refused; an explicit correction ID and note writes a distinct chain and correction manifest while preserving the originals. No activation is emitted unless an approval is admitted for the current revision.

I also fixed a readiness bug so an admitted approval for an earlier revision remains in decision history but cannot activate a later revision.

import json
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, FormatChecker
root = Path('.')
out = root / 'deliverables/snapshots'
schema = json.loads((root / 'snapshot.schema.json').read_text())
validator = Draft202012Validator(schema, format_checker=FormatChecker())
prior = None
for n in (1, 2, 3):
    path = out / f'batch-{n:02d}.json'
    data = path.read_bytes()
    snap = json.loads(data)
    errors = list(validator.iter_errors(snap))
    print(f'BATCH {n}: schema={"valid" if not errors else "INVALID"}; sha256={hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}')
    if errors:
        print([(list(e.absolute_path), e.message) for e in errors])
    if prior:
        actual = hashlib.sha256(prior[1]).hexdigest()
        pred = snap['predecessor']
        print(f' predecessor={pred["path"]}; independently_computed={actual}; matches={pred["sha256"] == actual}')
    else:
        print(f' predecessor={snap["predecessor"]}')
    apps = snap['applications']
    statuses = Counter(a['status'] for a in apps)
    decisions = [d for a in apps for d in a['decisions']]
    outcomes = Counter('admitted' if d['admitted'] else 'rejected' for d in decisions)
    reasons = Counter(d['reason'] for d in decisions if not d['admitted'])
    activations = [a for a in apps if a['activation'] is not None]
    admitted_ids = {d['decision_id'] for a in apps for d in a['decisions'] if d['admitted']}
    invalid_activations = [a['application_id'] for a in activations if a['approval_decision_id'] not in admitted_ids]
    unresolved = Counter(state for a in apps for state in a['elements'].values() if state != 'resolved')
    limited = sum(any('Unresolved export limitation:' in q['item'] for q in a['action_queue']) for a in apps)
    print(f' applications={len(apps)}; statuses={dict(statuses)}; cumulative_decisions={len(decisions)} {dict(outcomes)}; rejection_reasons={dict(reasons)}')
    print(f' activations={len(activations)}; invalid_activations={invalid_activations}; unresolved_elements={dict(unresolved)}; apps_with_limitation_followup={limited}')
    ledger = json.loads((out / f'evidence-ledger-batch-{n:02d}.json').read_text())
    print(f' evidence_batches={len(ledger["batches"])}; records={sum(len(b["records"]) for b in ledger["batches"])}; documents={sum(len(b["documents"]) for b in ledger["batches"])}; integrity_issues={sum(len(b["issues"]) for b in ledger["batches"])}')
    prior = (path, data)

const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import csv, json, hashlib, re
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, FormatChecker
root=Path('.')
exports=sorted((p for p in (root/'inputs').glob('Batch * export — *') if p.is_dir()),key=lambda p:int(re.search(r'Batch (\d+)',p.name).group(1)))
out=root/'deliverables/snapshots'
schema=json.loads((root/'snapshot.schema.json').read_text())
validator=Draft202012Validator(schema,format_checker=FormatChecker())
all_good=True
prior=None
source_app_revisions=[]
for i,folder in enumerate(exports,1):
    src_records={}
    for csv_path in folder.glob('*.csv'):
        with csv_path.open(encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f:
            src_records[csv_path.name]=list(csv.DictReader(f))
    src_docs=sorted((p.relative_to(folder).as_posix() for sub in ('letters','dispositions','decisions') for p in (folder/sub).glob('*.md')))
    ledger=json.loads((out/f'evidence-ledger-batch-{i:02d}.json').read_text())
    batch=ledger['batches'][-1]
    ledger_rows=Counter(r['filename'] for r in batch['records'])
    actual_counts={name:len(rows) for name,rows in src_records.items()}
    ledger_docs=sorted(d['path'] for d in batch['documents'])
    csv_ok=all(actual_counts.get(k,0)==v for k,v in ledger_rows.items()) and len(batch['records'])==sum(actual_counts.values()) and ledger_docs==src_docs and not batch['issues']
    source_app_revisions.append({(r['application_id'],r['revision']) for r in src_records['applications.csv']})
    cumulative_pairs={(r['values']['application_id'],r['values']['revision']) for b in ledger['batches'] for r in b['records'] if r['filename']=='applications.csv'}
    cumulative_apps={a for a,_ in cumulative_pairs}
    snap_path=out/f'batch-{i:02d}.json'
    snap_bytes=snap_path.read_bytes(); snap=json.loads(snap_bytes)
    schema_ok=not list(validator.iter_errors(snap))
    expected_pairs=set().union(*source_app_revisions[:i])
    pair_ok=cumulative_pairs==expected_pairs and len(cumulative_apps)==40
    max_revs={app:max(int(rev) for a,rev in cumulative_pairs if a==app) for app in cumulative_apps}

    expected=set().union(*source_pairs[:i]); apps={a for a,_ in pairs}
    maxrev={a:max(int(rev) for aid,rev in pairs if aid==a) for a in apps}

    latest={a['application_id']:a['revision'] for a in snap['applications']}
    schema_ok=not list(validator.iter_errors(snap)); revisions_ok=pairs==expected and len(apps)==40 and latest==maxrev and len(latest)==40
    chain_ok=snap['predecessor'] is None if previous is None else snap['predecessor']=={'path':previous[0],'sha256':hashlib.sha256(previous[1]).hexdigest()}
    decisions=[d for a in snap['applications'] for d in a['decisions']]
    dm=Counter(d['reason'] for d in decisions if not d['admitted'])
    activation_ok=all(a['activation'] is None or (a['approval_decision_id'] in {d['decision_id'] for d in a['decisions'] if d['admitted']}) for a in snap['applications'])
    queue_ok=all(not a['packet_presentable'] and any(q['item'].startswith('Unresolved export limitation:') for q in a['action_queue']) for a in snap['applications'])
    check_app={'1':'APP-2026-001','2':'APP-2026-039','3':'APP-2026-036'}[str(i)]
    example=next(a for a in snap['applications'] if a['application_id']==check_app)
    queue_text='\n'.join(q['item'].casefold() for q in example['action_queue'])

    stats=Counter(a['status'] for a in snap['applications'])
    print(f'BATCH {i}: source rows {row_count} vs ledger {len(b["records"])}; docs {len(source_docs)} vs ledger {len(b["documents"])}; integrity={len(b["issues"])}; source/ledger PASS={source_ok}')
    print(f'  apps={len(apps)}; revision_pairs={len(pairs)}; all prior revisions retained and latest snapshot revision matches PASS={revisions_ok}; schema PASS={schema_ok}; predecessor PASS={chain_ok}')
    print(f'  decisions={len(decisions)}; admitted={sum(d["admitted"] for d in decisions)}; rejected={sum(not d["admitted"] for d in decisions)}; reasons={dict(dm)}; statuses={dict(stats)}')
    print(f'  activations={sum(a["activation"] is not None for a in snap["applications"])}; activation guard PASS={activation_ok}; unresolved queues PASS={queue_ok}; sample missing/unassessable evidence PASS={evidence_ok}')
    checks.extend([source_ok,revisions_ok,schema_ok,chain_ok,activation_ok,queue_ok,evidence_ok])
    previous=(snap_path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),raw)
# Inspect each unique source decision and the roster's body/outcome restrictions.
ledger=json.loads((out/'evidence-ledger-batch-03.json').read_text())
docs={}
for b in ledger['batches']:
    for d in b['documents']:
        if '/decisions/' in '/'+d['path']:
            fields={k.casefold():v.strip() for k,v in re.findall(r'^\*\*([^*]+):\*\*\s*(.*?)\s*$',d['content'],re.M)}
            docs[fields['decision id']]=fields
allowed={'credentials committee':{'recommended','not recommended','deferred-pending-information'},'executive committee of the medical staff':{'recommended','not recommended','deferred-pending-information'},'governing body':{'approved','approved-with-conditions','deferred-pending-information','denied'}}
wrong=[]
for did,f in docs.items():
    if f.get('outcome','').casefold() not in allowed.get(f.get('body','').casefold(),set()): wrong.append((did,f.get('body'),f.get('outcome')))
final=json.loads((out/'batch-03.json').read_text())
records={d['decision_id']:d for a in final['applications'] for d in a['decisions']}
source_authority_ok=len(docs)==56 and not wrong and records['MEC-2026-036']['admitted'] is False and records['MEC-2026-036']['reason']=='body-or-outcome-not-authorized'
print(f'AUTHORITY: unique source decision docs={len(docs)}; body/outcome violations={wrong}; MEC-2026-036 refused for reserved approval authority={source_authority_ok}; PASS={source_authority_ok}')
checks.append(source_authority_ok)
print('INDEPENDENT_CHECKS='+('PASS' if all(checks) else 'FAIL'))
raise SystemExit(0 if all(checks) else 1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate validated, append-only Project E snapshots for closed batches."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys
import tempfile
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, FormatChecker

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from credentialing.ingestion import empty_ledger, ingest_batch
from credentialing.readiness import process_recorded_decisions


def _json_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def _relative(path: Path, root: Path) -> str:
    try:
        return path.resolve().relative_to(root.resolve()).as_posix()
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"Output path must be inside repository root to keep snapshot links repository-relative: {path}") from exc


def _source_label(ref: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    batch = ref.get("batch_id", "unknown-batch")
    if ref.get("filename"):
        location = str(ref["filename"])
        if ref.get("row_number") is not None:
            location += f":{ref['row_number']}"
    else:
        location = str(ref.get("document_path", "source document"))
    return f"{batch}/{location}"


def _application_entries(ledger: dict[str, Any], as_of: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    revisions: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    for batch in ledger["batches"]:
        if batch["export_date"] > as_of:
            continue
        for record in batch["records"]:
            if record["filename"] != "applications.csv":
                continue
            values = record["values"]
            if values.get("application_id") and values.get("revision"):
                revisions.setdefault(str(values["application_id"]), []).append(values)

    entries = []
    for application_id in sorted(revisions):
        app_rows = revisions[application_id]
        latest_by_revision: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for values in app_rows:
            try:
                number = int(values["revision"])
            except (KeyError, ValueError):
                continue
            latest_by_revision[number] = values
        if not latest_by_revision:
            continue
        revision = max(latest_by_revision)
        result = process_recorded_decisions(ledger, application_id, revision, as_of)
        fragment = result["schema_compatible"]
        readiness = result["readiness"]
        actions = list(fragment["action_queue"])
        for blocker in readiness.get("blockers", []):
            refs = blocker.get("evidence", [])
            suffix = "" if not refs else " Evidence: " + ", ".join(_source_label(ref) for ref in refs) + "."
            if not refs:
                suffix = " Evidence source is not identifiable in this export."
            actions.append({
                "item": f"{blocker.get('element', 'packet')} — {blocker.get('message', blocker.get('code', 'unresolved'))}.{suffix}",
                "owner": "Medical Staff Office",
                "due": None,
            })
        for detail in result["decision_details"]:
            if detail["admitted"]:
                continue
            source = detail.get("source", {})
            actions.append({
                "item": (f"Record decision {detail['decision_id']} against revision {detail.get('revision')} was not admitted: "
                         f"{detail.get('admission_reason')}. Source: {_source_label(source)}."),
                "owner": "Medical Services Professional",
                "due": None,
            })
        for limitation in result.get("limitations", []):
            actions.append({
                "item": f"Unresolved export limitation: {limitation}",
                "owner": "Medical Services Professional",
                "due": None,
            })

def main() -> int:

    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        print(f"Error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

        validator = Draft202012Validator(
            schema, format_checker=FormatChecker()
        )
        errors = sorted(validator.iter_errors(snapshot), key=lambda error: list(map(str, error.absolute_path)))

        return 1

            location = ".".join(str(part) for part in error.absolute_path) or "$"
            print(f"  {location}: {error.message}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    print(f"Valid snapshot: {args.snapshot}")
    return 0
